jobs.title: Software Engineer, Systems ML - Compilers
jobs.description:
Reality Labs (RL) focuses on delivering Meta's vision through Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR) and Wearable AI Devices. The compute performance and power efficiency requirements of our AI devices require custom silicon. Reality Labs Silicon team is driving the state of the art forward with breakthrough work in computer vision, machine learning, mixed reality, graphics, displays, sensors, and new ways to map the human body. Our chips will unlock personalized on\-device AI capabilities and blend virtual, physical worlds on wearable devices. We believe the only way to achieve our goals is to look at the entire stack, from transistors, through architecture, firmware, and algorithms.We are seeking a software engineer to support the development of the compiler tool\-chain for state\-of\-the\-art deep learning hardware components optimized for AR/VR systems. You will be part of our efforts to architect, design and implement a clean slate compiler for this activity and will be part of a team that includes compiler, machine learning algorithms and software, firmware and ASIC experts. You will contribute to a full stack development effort compiling PyTorch models down to binaries for custom hardware accelerator blocks.  

  

  

### **Software Engineer, Systems ML \- Compilers Responsibilities:**

* Lead the architecture and implementation of ML compiler infrastructure, including intermediate representations (IR), optimization passes, and code generation targeting custom AI accelerators
* Design and implement compiler transformations informed by hardware architecture constraints for GPU, TPU, and edge AI accelerators
* Drive the development of LLVM/MLIR\-based toolchains for compiling PyTorch models to optimized binaries for custom silicon
* Work with hardware architects to co\-design compiler features that maximize performance, power efficiency, and programmability for edge devices
* Analyze and improve the efficiency, scalability, and stability of compiler toolchains, ensuring they can be extended to new hardware targets
* Lead technical roadmapping for compiler infrastructure initiatives, coordinate execution across teams, and mentor engineers on compiler design patterns
* Conduct design and code reviews, evaluate code performance, and drive resolution of compiler and cross\-disciplinary system issues
* Interface with other compiler\-focused teams (PyTorch, ExecuTorch) to evaluate and incorporate innovations

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 3\+ years of experience in developing compilers, toolchains, or code optimization software
* Experience with LLVM, MLIR, or similar compiler infrastructure frameworks
* Experience in designing intermediate representations and implementing compiler optimization passes
* Experience with hardware architectures such as GPUs, TPUs, or custom AI accelerators
* Experience in software development using C\+\+ for compiler and systems\-level programming
* Experience leading end\-to\-end technical design and delivery of compiler infrastructure initiatives across multiple teams

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience developing in ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow at the system level
* Experience co\-designing software and hardware features with silicon architecture teams
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience with ExecuTorch, TensorRT, XLA, or similar ML compilation and deployment frameworks
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

jobs.description:
**Job Details**
===============


New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.


Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus\-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.


This unique opportunity is part of the **Mechanical and Control Systems Division (35\)**, which creates advanced mechanical, robotics, thermal, propulsion, onboard GNC, and electronic packaging systems. Division 35 develops hardware and systems from early architecture through design, fabrication, subsystem, and system\-level integration and test.

  

You will be working as a ***Structural Systems Engineer*** within the **Mechanical Engineering, Integration, and Test Section**, which leads the design, analysis, development, integration, and test of flight mechanical and robotic systems for spacecraft, payloads, and ground\-based systems. In this role, you will:

  

* Perform structural design and analysis to ensure the structural integrity of subsystem and system\-level hardware and the associated support structures.
* Perform structural analysis utilizing classical solutions and finite element analysis (FEA) method for flight projects and/or technology tasks and/or proposal developments.
* Perform detailed stress/structural analysis, dynamic analysis, and pre\-test analysis.
* Build finite element models from scratch, using hand calculations when appropriate, to determine critical areas in structure and determine efficient and adequate approaches for analysis independently.
* Contribute to the design process of mechanical assemblies from engineering requirements to engineering drawings including suggestions and feedback on areas of concern based on analysis, mechanical intuition, and engineering judgement.
* Support and present analysis results at team, line management, and technical reviews.
* Support and conduct static and dynamic tests and develop test reports.
* Perform tasks under the direction of the group supervisor, project management, and project technical leads, work independently and within a team environment, and collaborate on tasks that span a spectrum of disciplines.

 **Required Skills:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related technical discipline with a minimum of 3 years of related experience; or a Master’s degree with a minimum of 1 year related experience or PhD in similar disciplines.
* Experience and knowledge in structural engineering, analysis, and verification of flight structures (spacecraft or instruments), composite structures, mechanisms, and/or opto\-mechanical assemblies.
* Experience in MSC.Nastran, NX\-Nastran, FEMAP, Abaqus, MSC.ADAMS or LS\-DYNA.
* General knowledge of industry and/or academic practices and standards related to structural mechanics, finite element analysis, and structural verification testing.

 **Desired Skills:**

* Experience in completing structural analysis of complex and unique flight mechanical systems and detailed analysis of its components.
* Ability to present structural margins \& analyses to project management and provide design recommendations.
* Ability to develop and conduct structural verification test programs for space flight hardware.
* Ability to troubleshoot mechanical, mechanism, and/or structural anomalies and failures.
* Ability to develop innovative design solutions to meet design requirements and resolve technical challenges.
* Knowledge of Standards for Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD\&T) per American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME) Y14\.5\.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Excellent collaboration skills and ability to work across subject areas and organizations.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Data Platform
jobs.description:
**About Mind:**


Mind Robotics is building robots that learn from real\-world experience, and the data platform is what turns raw experience into training signal. Every day, sensor data flows in from multiple sources — arriving in different formats, at different volumes, and with different quality bars. This team owns what happens next: ingesting that data reliably, validating and curating it for quality and diversity, powering annotation, and building the automated methods that will increasingly do that labeling work.

**About the role:**


As a Software Engineer working on the data platform, you'll be one of the founding engineers on the team that owns our application layer, reporting to our Head of Application Engineering. The systems work today; your job is to help harden and productionize them for scale — ingesting from a growing number of sources and field sites, and turning raw captures into training\-ready data faster and at higher quality. This is early, hands\-on, 0\-to\-1 engineering: you'll build the pipelines and tooling that determine what data actually makes it into our models, and see the effect on robot behavior.

**You will:**

* Build data ingestion pipelines from multiple sources, including our own field capture and teleop stacks
* Build automatic data validation systems that catch quality issues before data reaches annotation or training
* Build and improve annotation ingestion, tooling, and workflows to increase labelling efficiency and throughput
* Own data quality and diversity — build the systems and metrics that tell us what data we have, what's missing, and where to focus collection
* Explore and build automated annotation methods, including running computer vision and vision\-language models for tasks like depth estimation, hand tracking, and auto\-labeling, to reduce manual labelling load over time
* Support the platform — debug issues in live pipelines, instrument for observability, and work directly with research and annotation partners who depend on your software

**Requirements:**

* 2\+ years of software engineering experience building production systems
* Strong programming fundamentals and comfort working across the stack — services, data pipelines, and applied ML tooling
* Experience with at least one of: real\-time or large\-scale data pipelines, ML data workflows, computer vision, or data infrastructure
* Bias for ownership: you've taken features or systems from prototype to production and supported them in the field
* Clear communication and close collaboration with product, research, and annotation/operations partners
* Hands\-on experience with sensor data (video, depth, IMU, force/torque) and the infrastructure to process, validate, and label it at scale is a plus
* Experience with streaming or near\-real\-time data pipelines is a plus
* Familiarity with ML data workflows (datasets, labelling, evaluation) is a plus
* Experience running or integrating computer vision or vision\-language models (e.g., depth, pose/hand tracking, open\-vocabulary detection, auto\-labeling) is a plus

---------------



Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in\-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. **Varda's W\-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in\-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C\-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.**



From life\-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.



Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.



Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.



Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in\-space ecosystem.

**About This Role**
-------------------



The **Senior Systems Engineer, Avionics** oversees the design, integration, and testing of avionics systems for our Winnebago Spaceship. They ensure that all systems are ready for both launch and operational phases, requiring a deep understanding of avionics system design, manufacturing processes, and operational protocols. They closely collaborate with various engineering teams and navigate conflicting requirements to achieve seamless system integration. Their expertise will be crucial in ensuring the vehicle meets its mission objectives, from space manufacturing to hypersonic testing during reentry.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Collaborate with cross functional teams to define project scopes and initial requirements, guiding designs from concept to prototype and full\-scale production.
* Develop electrical architecture, system diagrams, and budgets to account for power, telemetry, channel count, size, and mass predictions used to communicate closing vehicle solutions to company level objectives.
* Analyze architecture for potential faults and risks, develop comprehensive mitigation plans, resolve uncertainties, and collaborate on Fault Detection Isolation and Recovery (FDIR) or operational workarounds when hardware solutions are unfeasible.
* Conduct comprehensive verification plans for avionics systems on flight and HITL hardware, ensuring readiness for launch and compliance with mission objectives for space and reentry operations.
* Participate in mission operations as an Avionics specialist or system operator, where they'll determine system health, suggest corrective actions to reentry commit criteria for operational success.
* Oversee the integration of the Winnebago avionics systems, acting as the primary point of contact for integrated systems investigations.
* Design, build, and operate the Hardware In The Loop (HITL) testbeds, simulating the spacecraft on the ground to ensure all systems are mission ready.
* Develop avionics ground infrastructure, support the design and integration of test racks and R\&D equipment used to power and communicate with the flight vehicles. Contribute to developing engineering best practices, focusing on increased test automation and efficiency.
* Draw from their experiences to help mentor and train new engineers, fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement within the team.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------


* Education: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical field.
* Experience: 5\+ years of experience in system design, test planning, and validation.
* Programming Skills: Proficiency in programming and debugging with Python.
* Technical Expertise: Experience with power supplies, modular DAQ systems, RTD and 4\-20mA devices, and general test equipment.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**
-----------------------------------


* Proven experience taking vehicle electrical systems from concept to operational production.
* Prior experience setting up HITL testbeds, managing configuration control, and conducting system level tests.
* Familiarity with Unix environments and the ability to use command line utilities.
* Experience developing test cases and test equipment to meet vehicle operating conditions.
* Strong project or program management skills.
* Relevant prior roles: Avionics Hardware, FPGA Engineer, Electronics Test Engineer, Electrical Systems Engineer

**Pay Range**
-------------


* Salary range: Senior: $140,333 \- $179,314/ per year.

jobs.description:

Category: Engineering

### **Position Description \& Qualifications**

  

  

**Lead Systems Engineer – Navy Security Systems / Force Protection and Anti\-Terrorism Hardware and Software**

If you seek a rewarding, high profile and challenging position supporting the U.S. Navy, Serco has a great opportunity for you! As the Lead Systems Engineer supporting our Navy Physical Security Systems work, you will be part of a dynamic team providing systems engineering, configuration management, technology refresh, and mission support for Navy physical and electronic security supporting force protection and anti\-terrorism systems.


Bring your expertise and collaborative skills to make an impact on the safety and security of our sailors, installations, and mission\-critical Navy assets. In this role, you will lead technical planning, system baseline management, RDT\&E coordination, configuration database development, dashboard reporting, and cross\-functional engineering support to help ensure Navy physical security systems remain reliable, modernized, supportable, and aligned with customer requirements.


**In this role, you will:**


* Lead systems engineering activities supporting Navy physical and electronic security for force protection and anti\-terrorism systems. Systems include (but not limited to) Access Control, Surveillance, Intrusion Detection, Perimeter \& Infrastructure, and Command \& Control.
* Lead and manage RDT\&E efforts, including evaluation of emerging technologies, technology refresh planning, prototype assessment, integration analysis, and transition support.
* Support test and evaluation planning, technology demonstrations, system assessments, engineering reviews, and fielding readiness activities.
* Manage system hardware and software baselines, including configuration identification, change control, status accounting, and configuration verification activities.
* Develop, maintain, and manage a systems configuration database for Navy physical and electronic security systems, including hardware, software, interfaces, site information, lifecycle status, and configuration relationships, for drawings, HW and SW system versions, end of life/end of support tracking, and technical refresh/reset timelines and rollouts.
* Develop and manage a status dashboard to provide visibility into system configuration, modernization status, operational readiness, technology refresh priorities, risks, issues, and customer decision points.
* Perform technical planning, system integration, verification and validation, risk analysis, supportability analysis, and effectiveness analysis for total systems.
* Translate customer requirements, operational needs, and technical constraints into integrated systems engineering solutions that balance performance, schedule, cost, cybersecurity, and sustainment considerations.
* Coordinate with Navy customers, program stakeholders, vendors, field activities, cybersecurity teams, logisticians, and engineering staff to support system modernization, sustainment, and issue resolution.
* Review engineering deliverables, technical documentation, test artifacts, configuration records, and status reports to ensure alignment with customer requirements and program expectations.
* Identify technical risks, configuration gaps, obsolescence concerns, and system performance issues; recommend corrective actions and modernization priorities.
* Prepare and present technical summaries, dashboards, engineering recommendations, and decision\-support products for program leadership and Navy stakeholders.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and task coordination for systems engineers and other technical team members supporting the PS2 contract.

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.  



We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. Join us in this exceptional and thrilling work environment within a stellar company, where your technical prowess and creative contributions directly influence the lives of our customers daily, both now and in the days to come.

* You own the development and characterization of the process and equipment from concept to implementation on the line. This will start out on a pilot scale and ramp to full production depending on project phase.

jobs.title: Research Software Engineer I - Laboratory of Dr. Talmo Pereira
jobs.description:
The Pereira Lab at the Salk Institute for Biological Studies is seeking a Research Software Engineer to build and maintain the software that turns computer vision models into biological discovery. The lab develops SLEAP, an open\-source deep learning framework for markerless pose estimation used by research groups worldwide, and operates the research software, analysis pipelines, and computing infrastructure that carry model outputs through to published science. Research Software Engineers often come from science themselves — computationally minded researchers who found that they most enjoyed building the tools, software, and infrastructure that make discovery possible. The role sits at the interface of research and software engineering, but it is grounded in the research side: unlike a conventional software engineer who builds to fixed product specifications, a Research Software Engineer works shoulder\-to\-shoulder with scientists to turn their evolving needs into working tools. It is an ideal early\-career role for someone who has done research and discovered that they love to code and build systems, and it can serve equally as the foundation of a long\-term research software engineering career in academia or industry.

  



The Research Software Engineer I will own the research software behind the Institute’s plant root phenotyping program: containerized, GPU\-accelerated pipelines that take raw images from automated scanners, run deep learning pose\-estimation models over them, extract quantitative traits, and deliver analysis\-ready results to collaborating laboratories. The role spans the full path that data travels: the desktop acquisition software running on the scanners, Bloom — the web application and database where images and results live — the open\-source Python packages that extract traits, and the deep learning models at the center of it. In practice this means maintaining full\-stack web and desktop applications, releasing Python packages under rigorous continuous integration, running and improving model training and inference, and working directly with plant biologists to turn their experimental questions into reproducible analyses. The Research Software Engineer I works alongside the SLEAP team that develops the underlying pose\-estimation framework, and contributes to those open\-source tools as part of the role. Including a link to a GitHub profile (or equivalent portfolio) with examples of previous programming work is strongly recommended for full consideration. We recognize that code written for previous employers is often proprietary and cannot be shared publicly, so this is not required; however, candidates who can point to non\-coursework repositories — such as personal projects or contributions to open\-source software will be highly preferred.


**Who We Are**



The Salk Institute is an internationally renowned research institution that values all (https://www.salk.edu/about/our\-community/) members of our scientific community. We seek bold and interactive leaders passionate about exploring new frontiers in science. Our collaborative community embraces perspectives across discipline, professional acumen, and unique life experiences, fostering innovation, and a sense of belonging. Together, we strive to improve the wellbeing of humanity through groundbreaking research.



Founded by Jonas Salk, developer of the first safe and effective polio vaccine, the Institute is an independent, nonprofit research organization and architectural landmark: small by choice, intimate by nature, and fearless in the face of any challenge. Salk's vibrant community has many talented individuals from varied backgrounds, each playing a crucial role in driving our mission forward. From visionary leaders (https://www.salk.edu/about/management\-team/) to dedicated administrators (https://www.salk.edu/administration/) and brilliant faculty members (https://www.salk.edu/science/directory/faculty/), the Institute is united by a shared passion for scientific exploration and innovation.


**What Your Key Responsibilities Will Be**


* Develop, maintain, and release open\-source scientific Python packages for pose\-estimation\-based phenotyping, following professional software engineering practices including version control (Git), code review, testing, type checking, and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD).
* Maintain and extend Bloom, the lab’s web application and scientific database for plant phenotyping data, spanning backend services, the API, the web frontend, schema design, and deployment on self\-hosted infrastructure.
* Maintain and release Bloom Desktop, the Electron/React application used on the plate and cylinder scanners to acquire images and upload them to Bloom, including its integration with camera and data\-acquisition hardware.
* Stand up, deploy, and maintain self\-hosted systems and services on lab servers and cloud infrastructure, including database backup and restore, object storage, and TLS certificate management.
* Build, operate, and improve containerized, GPU\-accelerated analysis pipelines that carry raw imaging data through deep learning inference to quantitative trait outputs.
* Train, evaluate, and deploy deep learning pose\-estimation models, and maintain the datasets, configurations, and model registries that make training runs reproducible.
* Connect analysis pipelines to Bloom through well\-defined data contracts, provenance tracking, and write\-back of results to the database.
* Run analyses on experimental datasets for collaborating laboratories and deliver the results as documented, reproducible reports and figures.
* Support and make use of shared high\-performance computing resources, including GPU cluster scheduling and containerized job workflows (e.g., Kubernetes\-based schedulers, SLURM).
* Rapidly prototype, build, and iterate on internal applications, command\-line tools, and utilities in response to evolving scientific needs.
* I

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. The role is part of the In\-Space Systems business unit, which is focused on addressing two of the most compelling challenges in spaceflight today: space infrastructure and increasing mobility on\-orbit.
**Role Overview**

BNS Core Systems and Components is seeking a highly experienced Senior Controls Engineer to lead the architecture, development, integration, and qualification of spacecraft attitude\-control actuators and momentum\-management systems. This role will focus on Reaction Wheel Assemblies (RWAs), associated motor\-control electronics, embedded flight software, FPGA development, and control algorithms.


The ideal candidate brings 15\+ years of direct experience developing reaction wheel systems for aerospace applications, with deep technical expertise spanning controls modeling and implementation, electric motor drives, embedded systems, and hardware/software integration. jobs.description:
**Sierra Space Careers:**
=========================


At Sierra Space, we build the missions and systems that keep our world secure in the domain above Earth.

  



Sierra Space team members share a spirit of innovation and collaboration and a belief that we can deliver on the boldest missions in space today. Together with our customers, we aim to safeguard our nation, sustain human presence in space, and secure the freedom of operations in low Earth orbit and beyond.


Our success is measured by the trust of those who rely on what we build and deliver, and our technologies keep the United States and its allies mission\-ready throughout space.


We are mission\-driven, and together, we are an extraordinary team.

**About the Role**
==================


The Systems Engineer III contributes to the development and implementation of advanced system solutions by providing alignment, connection and direction to the technical team throughout the product development lifecycle. The Systems Engineer III represents the viewpoint of the integrated whole during system development and works to glue segments and subsystems together via top\-down decomposition of stakeholder requirements, traceability through development artifacts, and bottom\-up validation and verification of the system. They help to shepherd the team through technical development milestones, track performance measures and identify technical risks to arrive at a compliant and cohesive system solution. The Systems Engineer III is an emerging leader in Systems Engineering principles and is proficient in the majority of systems engineering skills including requirements management, system architecture development, concept of operation definition, system integration and system verification. AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. jobs.title: Specialist, Software Engineer (Palm Bay)
jobs.description:
L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high\-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work\-life success. Fundamental to our culture is an unwavering focus on values, dedication to our communities, and commitment to excellence in everything we do.


L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission\-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end\-to\-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

**Job Title: Specialist, Software Engineering – Embedded C2**  

**Job Code: 44998**  

**Job Location: Palm Bay, Florida**  

**Job Schedule: 9/80 \- Employees work 9 out of every 14 days \- totaling 80 hours worked (Every Other Friday Off)**  

  

**Job Description:**  

Join L3H and the Liberator team to develop command and control software for systems operating in real\-world deployed environments. You will turn complex mission and platform needs into secure, resilient software that connects embedded computing, communications, and hardware at the edge. This is a hands\-on role for an engineer who enjoys taking a system from bench bring\-up through integration, verification, and field\-ready deployment.  

  

**Essential Functions:**  

* Design, develop, integrate, and sustain embedded command and control software for CSE \& Liberator deployed systems.
* Build, configure, harden, and maintain embedded Linux images on ARM and single\-board\-computer platforms.
* Implement secure platform capabilities, including signed boot, chain of trust, TPM2, U\-Boot, keys and OTP, measured boot, and LUKS disk encryption.
* Develop Python services and automation for networked applications, messaging, concurrency, and protocol handling; contribute C/C\+\+ firmware for microcontroller\-class platforms as needed.
* Bring up and debug hardware\-in\-the\-loop and bench environments using serial interfaces, GPIO, digital I/O, wiring diagrams, and board\-level electrical interfaces.
* Configure deployed Linux systems, including networking, firewall rules, systemd services, time synchronization, logging, and provisioning workflows.
* Develop and execute test procedures, investigate defects, and produce verification evidence supporting integration and release readiness.
* Improve embedded development, integration, and test workflows through CI/CD automation and responsible use of agentic AI development tools.
* Possess or ability to obtain TS/SCI Clearance w/ CI Poly.

  

**Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor’s Degree and minimum 4 years of prior relevant experience. Graduate Degree and a minimum of 2 years of prior related experience. In lieu of a degree, minimum of 8 years of prior related experience.

  

**Preferred Additional Skills:**  

* Embedded Linux on ARM or single\-board platforms, including image builds, hardening, provisioning, and administration.
* Secure boot and platform security: signed boot, TPM2, U\-Boot, keys/OTP, measured boot, and LUKS.
* Python network services and automation; C/C\+\+ embedded firmware development.
* Hardware/software integration, HIL bring\-up, test execution, verification, and serial, GPIO, or digital I/O debug.
* Safety\-, mission\-, or fault\-tolerant control systems; microcontroller or PLC platforms.
* Defense cybersecurity, including DISA STIGs, ATO support, or TS/SCI eligibility.
* Reliable transport or protocol design for low\-bandwidth acoustic or RF communications.
* CI/CD and AI\-assisted development for embedded or hardware\-in\-the\-loop workflows.
* Marine, subsea, harsh\-environment, or power\-constrained systems.

jobs.description:

As an experienced **Software Engineer III \- Java Full Stack Developer** you will have the ability to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as a consultant without the extensive demands of travel. **Work you'll do/Responsibilities**  

  

Join our AI and Systems Co\-Design team, pioneering high\-performance software and hardware technologies for AI and next\-generation consumer devices. As a Consultant, you'll help design, build, and optimize foundational tools and applications that power cutting\-edge AI platforms and smart devices. You'll collaborate cross\-functionally, tackle large\-scale technical challenges, and deliver innovative solutions with global impact.

* Develop scalable, high\-performance APIs and event\-driven components for market technology applications.
* Write efficient multithreaded Java code and troubleshoot performance, concurrency, and reliability issues.

* Collaborate with product, architecture, QA, and DevOps teams to deliver secure, stable, and production\-ready solutions.
* Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, sprint ceremonies, and production support as needed.

* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines

* 6\+ years of experience developing or deploying AI solutions, custom hardware, or high\-performance platforms.

### **Position Description \& Qualifications**

  

  

If you love high profile and challenging projects supporting the Naval Surface Warfare Center (NSWC), then Serco has a great opportunity for you!

  



As the Experienced Electrical Engineer working onsite NSWC PCD located in Panama City, Florida, you will be integrated within a diverse team of multi\-disciplined engineers, and technicians supporting unmanned systems. Bring your expertise and collaborative skills to make an impact on our military defense and safety of our sailors by discovering your new role supporting this critical mission.

  



**This position is contingent upon the ability to obtain/maintain a DoD Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) Security Clearance**

  



**In this role, you will:**


* Lead the design of mixed\-signal hardware systems including microcontrollers (Arduino, ATmega, PIC, ESP32, etc.), power management systems (AC – DC converters, Transformers, LDOs), and sensor interfaces.
* Create detailed schematics and perform complex, multi\-layer PCB layouts using industry\-standard EDA tools (e.g., Altium Designer, Cadence OrCAD/Allegro, KiCad, Siemens Xpedition).
* Ensure strict adherence to best practices for signal integrity, power integrity, and EMI/EMC compliance.
* Implement microprocessors into designs using C/C\+\+.
* Run test simulations using Spice software (LTspice, Pspice, or equivalent).
* Assemble, test, and perform initial bring\-up of hardware prototypes.
* Utilize lab equipment such as mixed\-signal oscilloscopes, electronic loads, and multimeters to verify system performance against specifications.
* Develop and execute comprehensive hardware test plans, thermal testing, and reliability testing.
* Troubleshoot hardware issues down to the component level.
* Create and maintain engineering documentation, including hardware design specifications, BOMs (Bill of Materials), schematics, and detailed instruction documentation for end users.

  

**To be successful in this role, you will have:**


* Active Interim Secret Clearance with ability to obtain/maintain TS/SCI clearance.
* US Citizenship.
* Bachelor’s in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a strictly related discipline.
* 5 years of similar/related experience.
	+ Masters Degree will be considered in lieu of 2 years of experience.
* 3 years of experience in embedded hardware design and full product lifecycle development.
* Extensive experience in schematic capture and PCB layout tools (Altium Designer, Siemens Xpedition, or equivalent).
* Strong fundamental knowledge of both digital and analog circuit design.
* Experience with common embedded communication protocols, including I2C, SPI, UART, RS\-232/485, CAN, Ethernet, and USB.
* Hands\-on experience with standard electronics laboratory equipment for debugging and characterization (power supplies, electronic loads, multimeters, and oscilloscopes).
* Moderate proficiency in C/C\+\+ for embedded systems microcontroller programming.
* Fundamental understanding of EMI/EMC mitigation techniques and the ability to incorporate that into designs.
* Comprehensive understanding of fiber optic system components and how to integrate them into designs.
* Ability to troubleshoot and repair fiberoptic systems (multi\-mode and single\-mode circular mil and SC).
* Ability to travel up to 10%.

**Additional desired experience and skills:**


* Exceptional problem\-solving skills and a highly methodical approach to root\-cause analysis and troubleshooting.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly document processes and explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical groups.
* Highly detail\-oriented with a steadfast commitment to delivering high\-quality, reliable, and safe hardware.
* Ability to work both independently as a self\-starter with end\-to\-end design, and collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team environment.

  

Apply today to discover your place in our world!

jobs.description:
Orlando, Florida, US, 32837
Category: Engineering
Job ID: 35519
widget: Full\-Time
Requires the ability to obtain a TS/SCI and SAP/SAR.
Other
No \- Teleworking not available for this position
$103977\.88\-$173296\.47
  
### **Position Description \& Qualifications**

  

  

Serco seeks a **Simulation Systems and Test Engineer** for its Combat Air Force Distributed Mission Operations (CAF DMO) 3\.0 program in Orlando, FL. The CAF DMO 3\.0 program, via its Distributed Mission Operations Network (DMON), provides world\-class integration training in large force and small team formats to combat units around the globe against cutting\-edge threats in a boundless virtual battlespace. The U.S. Air Force can only utilize its full capability against modern threats in a virtual environment. Be a part of that environment and continue to make the USAF the best air force in the world.
You will be part of a focused team of engineers to perform test, integration, and evaluation of disparate M\&S systems and applications to support 5th and 6th generation training interoperability.
The team will work closely with the DoD customer and other Serco teams at Langley AFB and Orlando, FL to deliver quality test services.  

**In this role, you will:**
* Support military simulation system and application integration, evaluation, and interoperability test to support DMON and JSE training operations.
* Use industry\-standard tools for simulation test and evaluation to include Wireshark, simulation protocol analysis, and GFE and Commercial Computer Generated Forces (CGFs).
* Assist in detailed analysis of network and computational system performance including latency, bandwidth, jitter, and system occupancy measures.
* Help develop and maintain test plans and procedures to document and drive test activities.
* Draft comprehensive test reports based on completed integration, test, evaluation, and verification tasks performed.
* Assist in the development of CONOPS and multiple COAs for implementation and deployment of the evaluated simulation capabilities.
* Contribute to other areas of the engineering life cycle to include requirements review and assessment, training operations support, and basic system administration functions.
* Produce well\-defined, concise, and directed test procedures and test cases under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Support program and team processes by using tools from the Atlassian Suite of products to include JIRA, Confluence, Bitbucket, Bamboo, and X\-Ray.
* Participate in peer reviews, test bed maintenance and updates, and programming, testing, and debugging activities.
* Write and maintain scripts and support application (PowerShell, Cygwin, VBasic, etc.) programs, to enable efficiencies in test artifact creation and task execution.
* Help identify production and non\-production application issues, assist in developing solutions, and implement necessary changes.

  

**To be successful in this role, you will have:**
* A bachelor’s degree in an applicable STEM curriculum (e.g., Data Analysis, System Engineering, Math, Computer Science, Physics, etc.) or similar.
* 8 years of engineering experience performing test, integration, SW development, or embedded systems engineering activities.
* Experience with military simulation integration test DIS IEEE1278\.1 or HLA IEEE 1516 protocols, or similar communications or data protocols (SIP, VOIP, JREAP, etc).
* The ability to obtain a TS/SCI and SAP/SAR.
* Experience supporting DoD customers and personnel in a technical capacity.
* Familiarity or experience with development, test and evaluation of military simulation training or operational systems.
* Must possess, or obtain within six months, a DoD 8140 IAT Level II or higher (i.e. Security\+, CySA\+, CISSP)
* Up to 10% travel

  

**This position is contingent upon your ability to obtain/maintain/transfer your Secret clearance.**  

**Additional desired experience and skills:**
* An active DoD Secret Clearance with ability to obtain TS/SCI and SAP/SAR.
* Familiarity with tactical Military training systems, products, and capabilities.
* Exposure to or experience in M\&S development, test, and integration for constructive simulation systems and models.
* Knowledge of or experience with the Joint Simulation Environment (JSE).
* Possess or obtain within six months, a Linux OS certification (i.e., Linux\+, RHCSA etc.).
  

  

### **Company Overview**

WSP is currently initiating a search for an **Assistant Vice President, Electrical Engineer** for our Jacksonville, FL office location to help us grow our Property \& Buildings office Jacksonville. The ideal candidate will have both technical leadership and business development experience to help grow our Property and Buildings business in Jacksonville.
  

  

This role will actively participate in the full project cycle with a focus on complex sector work such as healthcare, pharmaceutical, life sciences, labs, and industrial manufacturing projects from the design phase through the final construction close\-out. Our Engineers work on high quality, high\-profile, national and international projects with our practice providing design services for over 30 million square feet of medical facilities.
  

  

We are a global leader in the practice of mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire protection engineering and related specialty services for the built environment. Our work is embedded in the residences we live in, the healthcare facilities we rely on for routine medical procedures to life saving feats of medicine, the skyscrapers and buildings we work in, and the operations of our buildings. * Prepare comprehensive technical reports and presentations that explain research, findings, concepts, and recommendations to address design, and/or construction issues or opportunities.
* Manage client relationship and provide key technical input on pursuit efforts.
* Develops relationships with key internal and external stakeholders.
* Exercise responsible and ethical decision\-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.

---------------

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or Architectural Engineering
* 10\+ years of relevant post education experience as an electrical engineer.

* Extensive knowledge of electrical design, particularly in the healthcare industry.

* Proficient with electrical engineering principles, practices, process, design/build, and the application to permitting and project work\-related issues.
* Experience with electrical planning, design, and construction management; including active involvement in a variety of renovation, new design, and construction projects.
* Well\-defined specific knowledge of relevant engineering and electrical construction laws, codes, regulations, compliance practices, and record\-keeping requirements.
* Well\-developed ability to make technical computations and calculations involving the application of electrical engineering principles, understanding plans and specifications, and making factual comparisons to the appropriate regulations.
* Demonstrated effectiveness at coordinating and assertively directing others to consistently complete tasks safely and efficiently.
* Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master’s Degree in Engineering.
* LEED AP Certification
* Previous Healthcare or Laboratory design experience.
* At least 5\+ years minimum of Project Management experience.
* 40\-Hour OSHA Health \& Safety Training (HAZWOPER) (29 CFR 1910\.120\) preferred.

jobs.title: Electrical/Electronics Engineering Technician- Uncrewed Maritime Systems
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**
--------------------

  


We are seeking a hands\-on Electrical / Electronics Engineering Technician to support the development, integration, testing, and operation of advanced uncrewed maritime systems.


This position will work closely with electrical, mechanical, software, and systems engineers to build, install, troubleshoot, test, and maintain electrical and electronic systems aboard uncrewed surface vessels (USVs), associated test platforms, and integrated payload systems.


The ideal candidate is comfortable working both at a lab bench and aboard a vessel, can build high\-quality electrical assemblies from engineering documentation, and is capable of systematically troubleshooting electrical and electronic systems in laboratory, dockside, and field environments.




**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

  

* Assemble, install, modify, and troubleshoot electrical and electronic systems used on uncrewed surface vessels.
* Support the electrical and physical integration of mission payloads, sensors, communications equipment, and other customer\- or program\-specific systems onto USV platforms.
* Assist engineering teams with payload power, communications, cabling, mounting, installation, checkout, and functional testing.
* Build cable and wire harness assemblies from schematics, wiring diagrams, cable drawings, and engineering instructions.
* Perform wire preparation, crimping, soldering, connector termination, labeling, routing, and harness installation.
* Install and integrate electrical enclosures, sensors, actuators, power distribution equipment, communications equipment, navigation equipment, and other vessel electronics.
* Support integration of DC power systems, including batteries, circuit protection, power distribution, DC/DC converters, relays, contactors, and associated wiring.
* Assist engineers with prototype assembly, system integration, design changes, hardware modifications, and rapid development efforts.
* Perform electrical troubleshooting using multimeters, oscilloscopes, power supplies, current probes, CAN/network diagnostic tools, and other test equipment.
* Diagnose wiring faults, power issues, communication problems, intermittent connections, sensor issues, and component failures.
* Support integration and troubleshooting of CAN bus, NMEA 2000, Ethernet, serial, and other vessel and payload communication interfaces.
* Perform continuity, insulation, voltage, current, and functional testing of electrical assemblies and installed systems.
* Support dockside, on\-water, and field testing of USVs and integrated payloads.
* Document test results, discrepancies, repairs, modifications, and as\-built configurations.
* Maintain organized wiring, labeling, workmanship, and configuration control throughout prototype and production builds.
* Provide feedback to engineering regarding manufacturability, serviceability, installation, and recurring hardware issues.
* Assist with maintaining laboratory equipment, tools, components, cables, and electrical inventory.
* Follow established safety practices when working around batteries, energized electrical systems, machinery, vessels, and marine environments.




**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

  

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in electrical/electronics assembly, integration, maintenance, manufacturing, field service, or a related technical environment.
* Ability to read and understand electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, pinout tables, mechanical drawings, and technical documentation.
* Experience with wire harness fabrication, connector termination, crimping, and soldering.
* Comfortable using a digital multimeter and standard electrical/electronic test equipment.
* Demonstrated ability to systematically troubleshoot electrical and electronic systems.
* Strong mechanical aptitude and ability to perform hands\-on installation and integration work.
* Ability to work independently from engineering drawings and instructions while effectively communicating questions, discrepancies, and technical issues.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to high\-quality workmanship.
* Ability to work effectively with engineers, technicians, operators, and other team members in a fast\-paced development environment.
* Ability to successfully complete required employment and program\-related background screening.
* Must be eligible and able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance if required by program or customer needs.




**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable:

* Marine electrical or marine electronics systems
* Payload integration or integration of customer\-furnished equipment
* Uncrewed vehicles, robotics, autonomous systems, or defense systems
* 12 VDC, 24 VDC, or 48 VDC power systems
* CAN bus, DroneCAN, or NMEA 2000
* Ethernet and serial communications
* GPS/GNSS, IMUs, navigation sensors, or autopilot systems
* RF, communications, cameras, or other mission payload systems
* Motors, motor controllers, actuators, pumps, or steering systems
* Battery systems and DC power distribution
* Environmental sealing and marine\-grade electrical installation practices
* Prototype development and low\-rate production
* PCB rework, modification, and component\-level troubleshooting
* Previous experience supporting DoD, government, or defense\-industry programs




**Travel Requirements**


This position will support engineering, integration, and test activities at multiple South Florida facilities and test locations.




* Regular local travel between company facilities and work sites in **West Palm Beach, Stuart, and Fort Pierce, Florida** will be required.
* Candidates must be able to travel between these locations based on engineering, integration, production, and testing needs.
* Occasional additional travel may be required to s

**Job Title: Associate, Electrical Engineering RF**

**Job Code: 38728**

**Job Location: Melbourne, FL**

**Job Schedule: 9/80: Employees work 9 out of every 14 days – totaling 80 hours worked, and have every other Friday off**

  

Job Description: L3Harris is seeking a Electrical Engineer with a focus on RF SATCOM System development for the Melbourne/Palm Bay, FL location. In this role you will be responsible for designing, developing, modifying, and evaluating RF systems/subsystems with a focus on receive and transmit chain equipment. A familiarity with reflectors and feed design is a plus. An RF Engineer ensures product designs meet company and/or customer requirements in terms of costs, results and manufacturability of end products.


This is an opportunity to take on unique challenges, expand your skills and experience, and contribute to mission critical systems solutions that help protect the U.S.A. and our allies. You will join a great team of talented professionals who take a collaborative approach and enjoy working together.


Essential Functions:


* Development responsibilities include the design of various passive and active assemblies including RF Converters, power dividers, amplifiers, mixers and filters.

* Design and develop sub\-systems and system level components to fulfill design objectives and to meet customer requirements.
* Conduct RF design analysis of components, sub\-systems, and systems through, computer simulation and mathematical calculations.
* Knowledge of how to implement designs based on requirements.

* RF/Microwave Engineers are expected to support the generation of specification and test documents, create original electrical designs, work jointly with Mechanical Engineering, CAD Designers, Machine Shop and Manufacturing to ensure efficient manufacturing of hardware.

As a key member of the Avionics Test Engineering team, the Principal Electrical Engineer will primarily support internal customers such as Factory. Here you will be given hardware and/or software tasks developing product tests for a variety of Collins Aerospace products. If you don’t want to be limited to only hardware or software engineering this position is for you, as knowledge of both are essential to this position.

  

The primary responsibility for this position is to develop and support manufacturing and service test solutions for Collins Aerospace products, participating in the entire development lifecycle. The engineer who fills this position will develop strong troubleshooting and problem solving skills. This position will heavily utilize hardware and software development and debug skills on multi\-rack test stations used to test Collins Aerospace products. These test stations may include but are not limited by the following test equipment: Digital multi\-meters, oscilloscopes, network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, logic analyzers, power supplies and electronic loads. This position will also support the development of thermal and vibration test equipment and software suites for environmental stress and screening requirements of Collins Aerospace products.

  

The ideal candidate will have an unwavering positive attitude, be highly responsive in a fast\-paced, team\-oriented environment, and strive to perform high\-quality work proactively and efficiently. This person will consistently demonstrate professionalism in their interactions with all levels of the organization and will routinely go above and beyond expectations in performing their work.

  

This is a multi\-faceted role requiring versatility across a variety of tasks in a highly collaborative environment. The role requires working closely with engineers and leaders, at various locations around the globe, to ensure project success. They will use independent judgment to make decisions in day\-to\-day job responsibilities the majority of the time under general supervision. Organizationally, the role reports to an Engineering Manager in the Avionics Test Engineering organization.

  

**What You Will Do**

* Review product designs and create test solutions that maximize test coverage in the manufacturing and service environments
* Design, analyze, test, integrate, and document hardware of moderate to high complexity
* Integrate and troubleshoot HW \& SW solutions
* Work closely with other engineering disciplines (e.g., mechanical and systems engineering) to ensure the electrical design is appropriate for the project/product design approach
* Ability to reverse engineer existing equipment (e.g., documenting something that is already built)
* Support automated test software development
* Create, review, and verify automated test procedures that will drive software development
* Prepare and present project / technical information to peers, internal management and customers
* Demonstrate excellent time management skills \- ability to multitask and delegate work to support technicians, engineering project assistants, and peers
* Develop schedule and budget estimates for engineering development activities
* Demonstrate knowledge of hardware processes, tools, methods, work flow, and best practices

 **Qualifications You Must Have**

* Must be able to read electronic schematics

jobs.title: Senior Electronics Engineer – New Product Development Robotics
jobs.description:
AutoStore™ holds a simple yet powerful vision: to store and move things for everyone, everywhere. Founded in Norway, we've grown into a global technology company. AutoStore uses advanced software to automate and orchestrate order fulfillment. Our goal is to ensure orders arrive faster than ever, with minimal environmental impact. That’s how we help brands exceed customer expectations.  



  

We have more than 1600 systems in nearly 60 countries, and we grow continuously as a community of employees, partners, customers, suppliers, and connected technologies. Automation should make life easier, and by listening carefully to our community, we innovate to meet the industry’s most complex needs. With AutoStore™, brands gain speed, efficiency, and improved workplaces. And much more floor space.  



  

AutoStore – moving things forward.  



  

  

**The Role:**

  

AutoStore is hiring a Senior Electronics Engineer who has carried new products to market. We are looking for an Engineer with experience taking a product from 0 \- 1, someone who has felt the consequences of their own design decisions at 10,000 units, not 10\. The successful engineer will have owned PCBAs through the messy parts: EMC chamber failures two weeks before certification, yield drops at the EMS partner, and the design trade\-offs required to recover without compromising long\-term reliability.  



  

**Key Tasks and Responsibilities:**

  

**PCBA Ownership – Concept Through to Serial Production Ready**

* Set hardware architecture, component strategy, and BOM cost/risk profile for assigned boards.
* Schematic design and layout; own signal integrity, power integrity, and thermal outcomes.
* Lead bring\-up and root\-cause analysis.
* Own EMC and safety compliance, from design\-for\-EMC through pre\-compliance and formal certification.
* Lead DFM/DFT/DFx with EMS partners; define production test strategy and coverage.
* Own NPI, pilot builds, and 0\-series.
* Partner with firmware on control discussions, implementation and fault handling.
Design robust technology with the noise immunity a moving robotic platform demands.  
* 

  

**System and Organizational Contribution**

* Contribute to electronics design standards, reusable building blocks, and design review practice in functional excellence groups.
* Assess how your designs could impact the wider AutoStore portfolio through a platform approach, and flag cross\-product benefits and drawbacks.
* Working within a cross\-functional NPD team and foster multidiscipline collaboration between functional disciplines.
Mentor to mid\-level and junior engineers; you review their designs and help raise the bar of the team, not just your own output.  
* 

  

**Key Qualifications:**

* Master's in Electronics or equivalent.
* 7\+ years in electronics engineering spanning analog, digital, and power electronics.
* How owned design for high\-volume manufacturing with global EMS suppliers.
* Dealt with sensor interface design and embedded communication bus design in electrically noisy, electromechanical environments.
* Experienced with CAN, SPE/Ethernet, I2C, RS\-485, etc.
* Architected and designed advanced motor driver PCBAs and power electronics.
* Experience designing embedded electronics and systems ranging from resource constrained microcontroller platforms to Linux based embedded systems.
* Dealt with safety and compliance issues around fault detection, safe state designs and diagnostics.
* Deep and practical EMC competence — design\-for\-EMC, not just test attendance.
* DFM \& DFT for high\-volume electromechanical products.
* Battery\-powered systems and system power budgeting.
Demonstrated technical leadership: setting direction for others, reviewing designs, and mentoring.  
* 

  

**We Offer:**

  

AutoStore believes in taking care of employees and is dedicated to providing a supportive and rewarding work environment. Join us in our mission to store and move things for everyone, everywhere.


* Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans
* Health Savings Account (HSA) with a company contribution
* Generous Paid Time Off including 12 holidays, paid exercise time, paid volunteer time, and paid parental leave plans for all new parents
* Retirement 401(k) plan with employer match and discretionary profit sharing contribution
* Educational assistance and professional development programs, including mentorship/coaching programs with external industry leaders
Additional benefits include Group Life Insurance, Voluntary Additional Life Insurance, Disability Insurance, Employee Assistance programs, and more!  
* 

  

AutoStore is an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, pregnancy\-related conditions, and lactation), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances.

* Engineer license required (multi\-state preferred).
* Extensive knowledge of electrical design, particularly in the healthcare industry.
* Known in the local community with an extensive network.
* Proficient with electrical engineering principles, practices, process, design/build, and the application to permitting and project work\-related issues.

With our three market leading businesses, world\-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

  

At Raytheon, the foundation of everything we do is rooted in our values and a higher calling – to help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression. We bring the strength of more than 100 years of experience and renowned engineering expertise to meet the needs of today’s mission and stay ahead of tomorrow’s threat. Our team solves tough, meaningful problems that create a safer, more secure world.

  

This onsite, entry\-level role located in Atlanta, GA

 **Job Summary:**

  

The Advanced Airborne RF Sensors department within the Space and Airborne Systems Engineering and Test Capability (SE\&TC) Center seeks talented Systems Engineers. Our team located in Atlanta, Georgia integrates hardware and software, develops test plans and procedures, debugs and evaluates system functions and interfaces, and verifies system requirements in support of final sell\-off to the customer. We put our systems together, exercise them in the lab and in the field, measure and analyze performance, and make sure our products work the first time and every time. Every day is a different set of challenges to overcome. You'll be expected to collaborate across disciplines and partner to implement solutions. In this role, you'll get to know a little bit about every aspect of the system and have a direct hand in making it all work together supporting teams of engineers engaged in integration and test efforts.

  

You will support Electronic Warfare product development, engineering testing, integration and flight\-testing, production, system deployment, and post deployment support across the product lifecycle. Through Digital Transformation (DTx) you will perform these functions using a variety of methods and enabling technologies, including Model\-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) and Agile product development.

  

This position is an onsite role in Atlanta, Georgia and Test event support activity may require travel which is not expected to exceed 20%.

 **What You Will Do:**

  

As a Systems Engineer, you will contribute to developing innovative solutions to technical challenges in signal processing design. Your responsibilities will involve assisting in the creation or modification of electronic warfare signal processing and control algorithms, as well as supporting the development and execution of test plans, simulations, and lab tests to verify system capabilities. You will help evaluate the functional performance of RF systems, including signal processing subsystems and firmware/control algorithms.


Additionally, you will assist in integration, verification, and troubleshooting activities in lab and field environments, utilizing test equipment to support root cause analyses and corrective actions. You will participate in preparing performance evaluations using tools like MATLAB, maintaining engineering specifications and drawings, and compiling findings for reports and briefings. Working alongside Engineering Integrated Product Team Leads (IPTLs), you will collaborate on team initiatives, attend meetings, and support the implementation of process requirements. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain hands\-on experience and grow your skills in the field of systems engineering.

 **What You Will Learn:**

  

After completion of comprehensive on\-the\-job training, the candidate will be a part of a team supporting systems engineering, integration, and test activities across the product development lifecycle.

 **Qualifications You Must Have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Science, Engineering, Physics or Computer Science (STEM preferred).
* Experience with tools, such as Microsoft Office, MATLAB or Python, for data analysis and automation
* Experience with troubleshooting technical issues with electronics in an academic or internship setting, including the use of common commercial test equipment (oscilloscope, spectrum analyzer, etc.)

  

Experience may be obtained through on\-the\-job experience, research, coursework, or projects.

 **Qualifications We Prefer:**

* RF system design, digital and analog signal processing, waveform and signal modulation characteristics and analysis, and/or algorithm implementation and testing.
* Experience with electrical schematics, interface control documentation, and communications protocols
* Experience integrating software and firmware onto electronic hardware systems
* Experience with reading and integrating software routines with hardware/electronics; C/C\+\+/C\# preferred

 **What We Offer:**

* Our values drive our actions, behaviors, and performance with a vision for a safer, more connected world. At RTX we value: Safety, Trust, Respect, Accountability, Collaboration, and Innovation.
* Relocation eligible

Are you passionate about developing, integrating, and testing large and complex weapon systems?
Are you skilled at working with large, dynamic teams, problem solving, and focusing on technical detail?
Are you eager to make critical contributions to a secure, sea‑based capability that guarantees our nation’s safety and security now and into the future?  

If so, then we want you on our team!  

We are seeking a Mechanical‑Systems Engineer to join the Launcher Systems Engineering section. You will work with a multidisciplinary team that supports our sponsors in developing advanced analysis methods for deployed systems, modernizing existing Navy hardware, and integrating new weapon systems onto Navy platforms. In addition, you will lead the creation of next‑generation systems and drive the transition from traditional Systems Engineering to Digital Engineering.  

As a Mechanical\-Systems Engineer, you will:* Gain a deep technical understanding of submarine launcher systems and other shipboard systems.
* Support system concept development, including traditional Systems Engineering tasks such as Requirements, Functional, and Physical Architecture development for complex systems.
* Engage directly with our Navy sponsor and associated prime and subcontractors to provide oversight of hardware design and production efforts for future weapon systems and Navy platforms.
* Participate in a wide variety of test and evaluation efforts, including full scale system tests conducted at government owned test facilities or onboard Navy platforms.
* Engage with multiple working groups across both government and industry.


  

**Qualifications** **You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you...*** Have a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related field.
* Have 3\+ years of relevant experience with Navy systems, particularly focused on product lifecycle management, hardware production, or Systems Engineering.

jobs.title: Software Engineer in Test, Humanoid Robotics
jobs.description:
Boston Dynamics seeks a highly technical **Software Engineer in Test** , to test the Atlas Humanoid Robot. In this critical, hands\-on role, you will be responsible for ensuring the reliability, safety, and performance of Atlas’s software systems, focusing heavily on metrics based system testing for reliability and performance.  



  

A key quality to be successful in this role is the exceptional ability to context\-switch and rapidly acquire technical understanding across diverse domains: from web interfaces and network protocols to robot behavior and ML model validation. If you thrive on learning fast, solving cross\-functional problems, and seeing your code directly impact a groundbreaking robot, this role is for you.  



  

Boston Dynamics is a world leader in mobile robots, tackling some of the toughest robotics challenges. For years, our awe\-inspiring viral videos on YouTube have shown the world what remarkably capable robots can do. Now we are quickly becoming a recognized leader in automation solutions for industrial applications and warehouse logistics.  



  

**What You’ll Do:**

  

* **Test \& Automation Design:** Design, develop, and maintain the comprehensive manual and automated overall regression test suite, focusing on integration stability. You will focus heavily on validating our teleoperation systems and action sequencing applications.
* **Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) Testing:** Perform automated testing with physical hardware in the loop, executing actual sequencing setups, physical interventions, and real\-time robotic test runs.
* **XR Applications Testing:** Drive the end\-to\-end quality of virtual environments by designing both automated and manual testing strategies for VR and Unity\-based applications used in robot simulation and operator teleoperation.
* **Release Contribution \& Reporting:** Contribute to generating detailed Test Execution Reports for major milestones and releases, clearly documenting coverage and communicating quality status to the manager and development teams.
* **Process Improvement:** Identify bottlenecks and gaps in the SQA process and testing coverage, driving continuous improvement in execution efficiency and reliability.

**Required Experience:**

  

* 3–4 years of experience in Software QA Engineering, Test Automation, or Software Development, with a history of shipping and supporting product releases.
* Hands\-on experience with **Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HIL) manual testing** , including physical test setup manipulation and live sequencing execution on robotics, automotive, or embedded systems.
* Strong proficiency in test automation with a solid base in Python, C\#, or a similar language. Direct experience automating **HTTP and WebSocket (WS) APIs** is required.
* Demonstrated experience testing **LLM / VLM systems** , including evaluating model responses via manual prompting, API layers, and setting up quality assessment metrics.
* Experience executing both automated and manual test strategies for **VR and Unity\-based applications** , simulation software, or interactive 3D environments.
* Expertise in designing comprehensive test plans and executing functional, integration, and regression testing with strong manual rigor.
* Expertise in Defect Lifecycle Management using defect tracking systems (e.g., Jira) for precise defect reporting, verification, and analysis.
Solid understanding of CI/CD practices and experience integrating and monitoring automated tests within continuous integration tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI).  
* 

  

**Nice to Have Experience:**

  

* Experience testing real\-time control systems or low\-latency teleoperation hardware/software.
* Familiarity with UI/UX and backend validation for complex workflow sequencing or orchestration applications.
* Operational familiarity with a Linux development environment (e.g., advanced bash/shell scripting).
Experience with Root Cause Analysis on complex, cross\-functional system failures.  
* 

  

*We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position.*

  

*The salary range for this position will be clearly stated in the job posting as required by Massachusetts law. The base pay range for this position is between $88,,000 \- $110,000\. Base pay will depend on multiple individualized factors including, but not limited to internal equity, job related knowledge, skills and experience. This range represents a good faith estimate of compensation at the time of posting.*

  

**Boston Dynamics will never ask you to divulge your personal financial or account information as part of its recruiting process.**

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

**ABOUT THE TEAM**
------------------



Anduril Cyber is focused on positioning Anduril as a lead provider of capabilities to enable offensive cyber missions. Cyber is a new business line at Anduril, and relies upon our fleet of autonomous vehicles, the Lattice operating system, mesh networks, and other hardware products to engage in cyber operations at the edge. We design and build novel solutions to deploy cyber capabilities in unconventional or difficult to reach environments.  

  

The new Lattice for Cyber team will build the core capabilities, experiences, and primitives that allow our Cyber products to operate reliably at scale. This is a founding team working from an unusually blank sheet of paper.


**ABOUT THE JOB**
-----------------



As a Software Engineer in Lattice for Cyber, you will build the core capabilities, experiences, and primitives that our offensive Cyber programs rely on. You will solve a wide variety of problems involving networking, autonomy, systems integration, robotics, and more, while making pragmatic engineering tradeoffs along the way.  

  

**Above all, Anduril engineers on this team are driven by a "Whatever It Takes" mindset — executing in an expedient, scalable, and pragmatic way while keeping the mission top\-of\-mind and making sound engineering decisions to deliver successful outcomes on\-time and with high quality. Not only will you build the software, you'll have the opportunity to work with the customer's to deploy it.**


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------


* Work with design teams and cyber subject matter experts to build a brand new UX product that enables US and allied nations to perform offensive cyber missions at scale.
* Design and build an extensible React\-based component system as a foundation for other cyber teams to build upon for their customer's use cases and integrations.
* Build the UX that powers our offensive cyber products such as command and control, autonomous cyber behavior trees, SIGINT analysis tools, and data exfiltration pipelines.
* Work directly with program teams and customers as they build real missions on your products.
* Contribute to technical leadership, design clarity, and long\-term maintainability across a growing software stack.
* Incorporate AI/LLM\-enabled workflow features where they improve analyst or operator effectiveness without compromising system reliability.
* Contribute back to the Lattice software platform core, allowing your products to provide value across the entire company.
