* 5\+ years of experience designing, building, and operating production software.
* Strong front\-end engineering experience in modern TypeScript/React application development, Angular, Vue.js or similar tools.
* Ability to debug across the full stack, including logs, networking, interfaces, configuration, and hardware/software boundaries.
* Practical experience with Linux and containerized deployment.
* Comfort collaborating with cross\-functional engineering teams and translating ambiguous requirements into clean user experiences.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for technical reviews and architecture discussions.
* Based in, or willing to relocate to, the Washington, DC or the Orange County, CA metro areas.
* Willingness to travel up to 20% of the time support program teams and customer events.
* **US security clearance eligible**

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------


* Exposure to AI/LLM integration patterns, inference workflows, tool orchestration, or model\-assisted application features.
* Track record of technical leadership, productization work, or direct customer interface in complex engineering environments.
* Prior work delivering into air\-gapped or otherwise constrained deployment environments.
* Hands\-on offensive or defensive cyber background.
* An active U.S. Security clearance.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Summary** :


The Senior Software Engineer contributes to the design, development, and ongoing support of custom software systems that power Little Caesars and affiliated companies. This role participates across the full software development lifecycle, including technical design, implementation, testing, and production support. The position supports the growth of team capability by providing guidance, mentorship, and day\-to\-day support to less experienced engineers, and may contribute to initiatives across LCE and other Ilitch organizations.


**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Technical Delivery \& Development**  

Contributes to the delivery of technical projects from design through production support, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards and methodologies. Owns the development of large system components and leads the delivery of small projects, while contributing to complex initiatives in collaboration with other team leaders. Produces high‑quality code that is flexible, reusable, and maintainable, and actively participates in build, release, and pipeline automation processes.
* **Software Design \& Problem Solving**  

Designs and develop software solutions by breaking down business problems into scalable, interacting components. Effectively navigates and debugs large, complex codebases, identifies appropriate solutions for ambiguous scenarios, and exercises sound judgment in refactoring decisions. Contributes to system architecture and design discussions, leads research and proof‑of‑concept efforts, and evaluates new technologies to inform engineering direction.
* **Quality \& Testing**  

Ensures code quality and system reliability through the development and maintenance of unit tests and by supporting integration and automated testing efforts in partnership with QA. Promotes engineering excellence through code reviews and adherence to testing best practices.
* **Agile Practices \& Collaboration**  

Actively participates in Agile processes, including sprint planning, estimation, reviews, and demos, and helps drive the creation of clear, actionable technical user stories. Collaborates with cross\-functional teams to identify dependencies, align on delivery, and ensure successful project outcomes.
* **Mentorship \& Knowledge Sharing**  

Serves as a senior technical resource by mentoring junior engineers, providing hands‑on guidance through pairing and coaching, and supporting onboarding efforts. Acts as a subject matter expert in key technical areas, promotes best practices, and contributes to knowledge sharing across the team, including supporting intern development.
* **Support \& Continuous Improvement**  

Provides ongoing support for production systems, including participation in an on‑call rotation, and leads root cause analysis and resolution of system issues. Proactively identifies opportunities for system, process, and tooling improvements, maintains support documentation, and contributes to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance team effectiveness and system performance.

**Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, or related field. Equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of a formal education.
* Minimum five (5\) years of hands\-on experience designing, building, and supporting software solutions in a professional environment, using one or more of the following technologies:
* Application development across web, mobile, or service\-based architectures (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks, .NET, Java, Python)
* API driven and distributed systems, including RESTful services and microservices
* Data storage technologies, such as relational, NoSQL, or unstructured data stores
* Cloud platforms or hosting environments, such as Azure, AWS, or equivalent
* Platform specific or systems development, such as mobile or embedded environments

**Working Conditions:**

This position may include on\-call responsibilities and occasional work during nights, weekends, or holidays. Work is typically performed in a standard office or remote environment, with some travel to restaurant locations or industry events as needed, in accordance with company travel policies.


**Competencies:**

The following competencies reflect the nature of the role and the environment in which it operates, rather than prescriptive minimum qualifications:


* **Hands\-On Technical Delivery**  

The role centers on individual contributions to complex, well\-scoped software development efforts, with a focus on quality and long\-term sustainable solutions.
* **Independent Problem Solving**  

The role requires identifying and delivering solutions to ambiguous or open\-ended technical problems with limited supervision.
* **Growth Mindset**  

The role requires a self\-motivated, curious, and creative approach to technology, including staying current with evolving tools, patterns, and best practices.
* **Collaboration \& Communication**

The role expects active participation in knowledge sharing, regular pairing with junior colleagues, and contributing to a positive, growth\-oriented team culture.
* **Engineering Practices \& Quality Focus**  

The role emphasizes disciplined engineering practices, including source control, unit testing, automation, code review, and secure development.

Success in the role includes applying formal software development methodologies, including agile approaches, and actively contributing to continuous process improvement.

**Job Description**

***At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. Through a human\-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt. We’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard —from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next\-generation safety and entertainment features.***

***Every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale.***

  

**The Role**

The AV Fleet Data Engineering team is responsible for the end\-to\-end design, requirements, integration, validation, and execution of AV/ADAS data\-collection capabilities. As a Senior Systems Engineer, you will lead the definition and delivery of Retail AV Data Collection solutions that support ADAS and automated\-driving development, fleet monitoring, machine\-learning data collection, regulatory compliance, and product improvement.  



  

You will translate stakeholder and customer use cases into system\-level strategies, feature\-level requirements, functional specifications, architecture concepts, and verification plans. This role will lead hands\-on systems engineering across vehicles, benches, simulation and playback environments, cloud/data pipelines, and connected fleet campaigns. The engineer will work closely with software, platform, vehicle integration, quality, data engineering, ADAS, AV, product, legal, and regulatory teams to deliver scalable and reliable data\-recording solutions.  



  

**What You'll Do**

  

* Gather and analyze stakeholder, customer, ADAS, AV, regulatory, privacy, and machine\-learning use cases.
* Decompose product requirements into stakeholder use cases, feature\-level specifications, system requirements, interfaces, constraints, and verification criteria.
* Define system strategies for recording triggers, signals, topics, recording durations, data quality, compute and storage budgets, data offload, privacy, consent, geofencing, and vehicle compatibility.
* Develop system\-level test strategies, use cases, test cases, functional checks, and validation plans for new functionality.
* Coordinate with software and platform teams to communicate requirements, defects, dependencies, risks, and release impacts.
* Ensure system designs account for customer consent, privacy, legal constraints, geofencing, regional requirements, and regulatory data\-recording needs.
* Support data\-collection request intake by clarifying use cases, identifying available signals, defining trigger logic, assessing pipeline limitations, and determining required software or architecture changes.
* Identify opportunities to improve requirements quality, systems engineering processes, test automation, configuration management, release readiness, and stakeholder communication.
* Make technical recommendations based on analysis, communicate lessons learned, and keep engineering leadership informed of assignment status, timing, risks, and technical issues.
Mentor engineers and contribute to reusable systems\-engineering standard work, documentation, and technical training.  
* 

  

  

**Your Skills \& Abilities (Required Qualifications)**

  

* 5\+ years of systems engineering, requirements engineering, embedded systems, automotive software, or related engineering experience.
* Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional technical activities involving multiple engineering disciplines.
* Experience translating customer or stakeholder needs into system requirements, functional specifications, interfaces, and verification criteria.
* Experience with requirements management and traceability tools, preferably DNG.
* Strong understanding of complex electrical, mechanical, software, and vehicle system concepts.
* High level of analytical ability and demonstrated success solving unusual or complex technical problems.
* Experience defining and executing system\-level test cases and validation strategies.
* Strong written and oral communication skills, including technical presentations and requirements reviews.
Ability to work independently, influence technical decisions, and drive issues to closure.  
* 

  

**What Will Give You A Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)**

  

* Experience with DNG, Jira, Confluence, SysML, UML, or similar systems\-engineering tools.
* Experience with CAN, LIN, GMLAN, FlexRay, Ethernet, SOME/IP, or other vehicle communication protocols.
* Experience with QNX, Linux, Android, Azure, cloud data platforms, or embedded software environments.
* Experience with MATLAB/Simulink, Python, shell scripting, or test\-automation frameworks.

**Job Description**

**The Role:**

  

General Motors is seeking a software engineering leader to modernize and scale the build systems that support software\-defined vehicles. This role will help lead the transition from a legacy Make\-based system to Bazel, Google’s open\-source build tool, improving speed, reliability, and robustness across the engineering organization.The successful candidate will drive this capability at scale, influence technical direction across teams, and help establish lofty platform capability goals.

* Lead high\-impact efforts hands\-on, solve complex and unusual problems, and communicate effectively as a coach and mentor while balancing technical command with empathy.
* Modernize a large embedded\-software build and test system by transitioning legacy Make\- or shell\-based workflows to Bazel and establishing scalable, reproducible, secure, and developer\-friendly infrastructure across repositories, toolchains, CI/CD, testing, and release processes.

Measures of Success

* Reduced clean and incremental build time, CI queue time, and developer feedback time.
* Increased reproducibility, approved hermetic\-toolchain adoption, cache effectiveness, and CI capacity.
* Lower build, pipeline, and flaky\-test rates, with improved diagnosis and recovery time.

Strong developer adoption, reduced support burden, and measurable productivity improvement.

* Deep understanding of software architecture for real time systems
* Experience shipping high quality safety critical products
* Exceptional problem\-solving and analytical abilities, with a keen attention to detail

OnTrac is seeking highly skilled and experienced Senior Software Engineers to join a contractor program supporting a healthcare / pharmacy benefit management (PBM) customer. The customer is staffing a team of three to four engineers to build REST API integrations with its Databricks data platform. This role is ideal for a hands\-on engineer who has moved clinical and pharmacy data between systems using healthcare interoperability standards, can write production code in both Python and C\#/.NET, and can become productive on a customer codebase with minimal ramp\-up. The successful candidates will work closely with the Lead Software Engineer, the delivery team, and customer stakeholders to ensure project success from initial definition through final delivery.


ENGAGEMENT


* Openings: two to three Senior Software Engineers, working alongside one Lead Software Engineer


* Location: United States, fully remote


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS


* Experience delivering software in the healthcare industry; pharmacy benefit management (PBM) experience strongly preferred


* Hands\-on experience designing and building REST APIs and system\-to\-system integrations


* Hands\-on experience with Databricks, including building pipelines and integrating external services with the platform


* Working knowledge of healthcare data standards: HL7 and CDA / C\-CDA documents


* Experience building data movement and orchestration with Azure Data Factory


* Experience with Azure SQL Managed Instance (or SQL Server), including schema design and query tuning


* Production development in Python

USEFUL QUALIFICATIONS

* Prior experience as an embedded contractor on a customer engineering team


SCOPE AND DELIVERY EXPECTATIONS

* Build REST API integrations between customer and partner systems and the Databricks platform

* Develop integration services in Python and C\# / .NET against Databricks and Azure SQL Managed Instance

jobs.description:
**Company Description**
-----------------------


**LEONI is a global provider of products, solutions, and services for energy and data management in the automotive industry. The group of companies has around 95,000 employees in 23 countries and generated consolidated sales of EUR 3\.9 billion in 2025 (excluding the former Automotive Cable Solutions division).**


**We believe that meaningful connections drive innovation and success. At LEONI, you will join a diverse, international, and collaborative team shaping the future of mobility, from autonomous driving to alternative drives and smart charging solutions.**


**With a 74\.9% ownership stake in LEONI, LUXSHARE is both the company’s majority shareholder and a strategic partner, actively supporting and enabling LEONI’s long\-term growth and success while contributing to its strategic direction.**


**LEONI’s customer base spans leading global automotive OEMs, commercial vehicle manufacturers, and component suppliers.**


**Join us and help drive the transformation of the automotive world.**


**Job Description**
-------------------


**Position Overview:**


*This position serves LEONI’s North American Development Department with expertise* *to organize our Systems Engineering effort* *in order to create and maintain E/E schematics in LEONI and customer’s systems.* The candidate should possess the capabilities to independently process E/E systems designs and to represent LEONI in front of our customers and partners. * Import Wiring DEF for all families including all sub\-suppliers (Large, Medium, Small, Data/Communication, HV, Battery, etc)
* Trouble shoot any issues in data and software and resolve with our customers and business partners.
* Train/support junior team members
* Create hrn/cmp/csv files from imported DEF
* Support def quality team with def checks
* Create system level DVP\&R
* Determine inline positioning
* Resistance check to meet system requirements
* Confirm design meets Terminal Plating and Special Requirements.
* Create subcomponent list (Terminal, Seal and etc) according to housing information
* Create inline list file (X/Y\-NUMs, Male/Female, connector p/ns, description, etc)
* Create inline pinout
* Create inline device transmittal (add special reqs and terminal plating)
* Wire gauge selection
* Provide splice information to DRE to integrate into 3D design.
* Wire harness troubleshooting for the full vehicle

---------------------------------


* Engineering degree (Mechanical/Electrical/Automotive preferred)

* Experience in Capital Logic/Integrator or equivalent schematics design tool
* Strong interpersonal skills; able to represent LEONI professionally with customers.
* Experience executing full‑vehicle systems engineering projects.
* Understanding of harness, inline, and device‑to‑harness partitioning.
* Knowledge of cable and sub‑assembly partitioning.
* Understanding of ground and network topology.

Candidate needs to be authorized to work in the U.S.

jobs.title: Associate Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
**Your Job**
As an Associate Controls Engineer, you will support the development, implementation, and improvement of automation and control systems within our manufacturing environment. This role is ideal for an early\-career engineer looking to build hands\-on experience with industrial automation, manufacturing equipment, and controls while working alongside experienced engineers and operations partners.


You will have the opportunity to apply your engineering knowledge to real\-world manufacturing challenges, develop your technical capabilities, and take increasing ownership of automation and controls projects.  

**Our Team**


You'll be part of a collaborative engineering and manufacturing team focused on improving automation, equipment reliability, safety, and production efficiency. The team works closely with operations, maintenance, quality, and engineering partners to solve problems and continuously improve our manufacturing processes.  

**What You Will Do**

  

* Develop, modify, and troubleshoot PLC, HMI, and industrial control systems
* Support automation and manufacturing improvement projects from design through implementation
* Troubleshoot electrical, controls, and automation issues on manufacturing equipment
* Participate in equipment installation, commissioning, upgrades, and validation
* Develop and maintain electrical schematics, I/O lists, controls documentation, and standard work
* Work with sensors, actuators, motors, drives, industrial networks, and other automation components
* Analyze equipment performance and downtime data to identify improvement opportunities
* Partner with engineering, operations, and maintenance teams to improve equipment reliability and manufacturing performance
* Support continuous improvement initiatives related to automation, safety, quality, and productivity
* Follow applicable safety requirements and engineering standards while working in a manufacturing environment

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**  

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, or a related engineering field
* Knowledge of industrial automation, electrical controls, and control system fundamentals
* Experience with PLC programming through coursework, internships, co\-ops, projects, or professional experience
* Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics and technical documentation
* Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills
* Ability to work effectively with engineering, manufacturing, and operations teams
* Comfortable working hands\-on with equipment in a manufacturing environment

**What Will Put You Ahead**  

* Previous internship, co\-op, or professional experience in controls engineering, automation, or manufacturing engineering
* Experience programming Allen\-Bradley, Siemens, or similar PLC platforms
* Experience developing or modifying HMI applications
* Familiarity with industrial communication networks and protocols
* Experience with variable frequency drives, servo systems, sensors, actuators, or robotics
* Experience using AutoCAD Electrical or similar electrical design software
* Exposure to equipment commissioning, machine controls, or manufacturing automation projects
* Experience identifying root causes and implementing improvements to equipment reliability or performance

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer (C++) - Trading
jobs.description:
Cargill’s size and scale allows us to make a positive impact in the world. Our purpose is to nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way.  

Cargill is a family company providing food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and industrial products that are vital for living. We connect farmers with markets so they can prosper. We connect customers with ingredients so they can make meals people love. And we connect families with daily essentials — from eggs to edible oils, salt to skincare, feed to alternative fuel. Our 160,000 colleagues, operating in 70 countries, make essential products that touch billions of lives each day. Join us and reach your higher purpose at Cargill.  

This position is in Cargill’s agricultural supply chain business. We sit at the heart of the supply chain, partnering with farmers and customers to source, make and deliver essential products.

**Job Purpose and Impact**
--------------------------



The Principal, Trading Engineering job leads and advises the design, development and delivery of trading software initiatives that drive the trading operations. This role is specifically suited for a C\+\+ developer with deep experience in the FIX protocol, leveraging expertise in both to build and maintain high\-performance trading systems. A key responsibility of this position is to help modernize trading solutions, driving the adoption of new technologies and best practices to ensure the trading platform remains robust, scalable, and competitive. As a recognized subject matter expert in trading engineering, this job provides technical thought leadership for the co\-creation and maintenance of sophisticated software applications vital to organizational trading activities, leading cross functional teams to conceptualize, design and adopt best in class industry standards and emerging technologies to improve the performance and capabilities of the trading systems and advance business objectives. This job also leads code reviews and insights and knowledge sharing to uphold the standards of excellence and advance trading engineering team's capabilities.**Key Accountabilities**
------------------------


* SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT: Leads and advises the design and implementation of robust trading systems, applying appropriate technologies to write clean, efficient and maintainable code, integrating market data feeds from financial providers and exchanges to process real time data, and customizing solutions to align with trading strategies and regulatory requirements.
* TECHNICAL GUIDANCE: Applies expertise in software development and deployment automation to mentor and support the software engineering team, improving trading applications' performance, scalability and reliability, and validating software architecture to support high frequency trading, real time data processing and low latency communications.

Twenty\-Six Defense, headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas, is a leading provider of high\-performance products, system solutions, and aftermarket support services focusing on the defense, homeland security, and commercial aviation markets. With facilities throughout the U.S., Twenty\-Six Defense is dedicated to supporting those who contribute to the national security of the United States. Twenty\-Six Defense is wholly owned by Elbit Systems Ltd. (NASDAQ: ESLT and TASE: ESLT), a global high\-technology company engaged in a wide range of programs for innovative defense and commercial applications.
  
  

**Job Summary:** The Senior Staff Systems Engineer – Seeker SME serves as the technical authority for the design, development, integration, testing, verification, and validation of Semi Active Laser (SAL), Imaging (EO/IR), and RF seekers for precision guided weapon systems. This role leads the development of seeker algorithms, performance simulation models, and end to end terminal guidance behaviors for all up rounds. The Seeker SME partners closely with cross functional teams \- optical, software, electrical, mechanical, GNC, and production \- to transition designs into production ready seekers.
  
As the primary subject matter expert, this position requires regular customer interaction and close collaboration with business development to shape technical roadmaps aligned with emerging needs. The ideal candidate has deep experience in laser seeker physics, RF radar/seeker architectures, signal processing, algorithm development, and full weapon system integration and test, including ground, captive carry, and flight testing.

* Design, Development \& Integration
* Lead design, development, integration, testing, verification, and validation activities for SAL and Imaging seekers, with added responsibility for RF seeker system analysis and architecture.
* Develop seeker performance simulation models for SAL, Imaging, and RF domains.
* Guide development of algorithms for target detection, tracking, angle estimation, filtering, countermeasure rejection, and terminal guidance performance.

* Partner with optical, electrical, software, mechanical, RF, and GNC engineering teams to drive robust, integrated seeker designs.
* Recommend and document seeker design updates to improve performance, robustness, manufacturability, and resilience in contested environments.
* Customer Interaction \& Roadmap Development
* Communicate technical concepts, risks, and decisions clearly to customers and senior leadership.
* Work closely with business development to shape seeker technical roadmaps aligned to customer needs, future mission profiles, and competitive landscape.

* BS \+ 12 years of relevant experience; MS \+ 9 years of relevant experience; PhD \+ 7 years of relevant experience
* Advanced technical expertise in seeker technologies, including AESA and phased array radars, monopulse angle tracking techniques, millimeter wave (MMW) seekers, multimode RF/SAL/Imaging seekers, and hybrid guidance architectures.
* Experience with optical phenomena relevant to SAL and Imaging seekers, including radome effects, optical/IR propagation, laser energy degradation through atmospherics, boresight alignment, optical distortion, and backscatter impacts.

* Familiarity with Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), including SysML/Cameo for system architecture, requirements modeling, behavioral diagrams, interface definition, and verification planning.
* Knowledge of weapon system environmental qualification, including ESS, vibe, thermal cycling, shock, EMI/EMC, and real world seeker survivability considerations.
* Experience supporting ground, captive carry, and flight test campaigns, including test planning, instrumentation, on range troubleshooting, and quick look analysis of seeker telemetry data.
* Background in countermeasure environments, including ECM/ECCM, SAL countermeasure rejection techniques, clutter suppression filtering, false target discrimination, target reacquisition logic, and terminal engagement robustness.

* Prior customer facing engineering experience, proposal support, technical roadmap development, and collaboration with business development on future seeker architectures.

jobs.title: Junior Electrical & Firmware Engineer
jobs.description:
Aescape is a New York\-based physical AI and robotics company redefining human recovery through intelligent, precision bodywork, elevating it into a consistent, outcomes\-driven practice.


Powered by real\-time body mapping, advanced robotics, and proprietary software, Aescape delivers deeply personalized bodywork that continuously adapts to the individual. This creates a superior way for members to move with greater ease, recover more efficiently, and optimize how they feel every single day.



Aescape is building a defining brand for recovery, shifting behavior from a sporadic experience into a progressive, measurable routine, unlocking compounding benefits that build lasting resilience and laying the groundwork for an entirely new category of proactive human health and performance.



Aescape powers recovery across leading fitness, hospitality, and wellness environments, including Equinox, Life Time, Marriott, Hilton, Four Seasons, Pause Studios, and Remedy Place, and is backed by Valor Equity Partners, BroadLight Capital, and Mecha Ventures.

**Aescape** is looking for a **Junior Electrical \& Firmware Engineer** to join our hardware team and work across the electronics and embedded software that make our robot move and sense. You will support schematic and PCB design, write and debug firmware on our embedded platforms, and spend significant time on the bench bringing boards up, instrumenting them, and fault finding across hardware and firmware. This is a hands\-on early\-career role on a small, senior team: you will be mentored closely by experienced engineers, given ownership of meaningful subsystems early, and you will ship hardware that real people experience with their bodies. If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!

**This role is based out of our NYC office in Chelsea, onsite 5 days per week.**

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Electrical Design Support:** Support schematic capture, component selection, and PCB layout review for motor drive, sensing, power, and control electronics. Read datasheets closely, run the calculations behind a part choice, and help carry boards from design through fabrication and assembly.
* **Firmware Development:** Write, test, and debug embedded firmware in C/C\+\+ on our microcontroller platforms: peripheral drivers, communication interfaces (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN), sensor integration, and device control. Work within our version control, code review, and release practices.
* **Board Bring\-Up \& Debug:** Bring up new hardware on the bench, and debug across the electrical and firmware boundary using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, power supplies, and debuggers. Solder, rework, and instrument your own test setups.
* **Test \& Characterization:** Build bench test setups, collect and analyze characterization data, and report what the data shows. Drive decisions from measured data and physics.
* **Manufacturing \& Supplier Support:** Support production test fixtures, design for testability, and electrical builds with our contract manufacturer and suppliers. Help triage and root\-cause issues found in manufacturing and in the field.
* **Cross\-Functional Partnership:** Partner with Mechanical, Controls, Software, and Operations on motor selection, drivers, sensors, and system bring\-up, and communicate what you find clearly to partners outside your discipline.
* **Documentation:** Produce the documentation others need to use your work: schematics, BOMs, wiring diagrams, test plans, and test reports.

**What You’ll Bring**
---------------------

* **Education \& Experience:** BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline, with 0–3 years of professional experience. Internships, co\-ops, research, competition teams, or substantial personal projects count.
* **Circuit Fundamentals:** Solid grounding in analog and digital circuit design, power electronics basics, and schematic capture in a professional tool such as Altium. You can read a datasheet and justify a component choice with numbers.
* **Embedded Firmware \& Python:** Working proficiency in C or C\+\+ on microcontrollers, bare\-metal or RTOS, with familiarity across common peripherals and communication protocols, and in Python for test automation and application\-level work. Comfortable with Git and code review.
* **Lab Skills:** Hands\-on with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, multimeters, and bench power supplies, and comfortable soldering and reworking your own boards.
* **Debugging Mindset:** You approach a failure with a clear question in mind: what is happening, why, and how would I prove it. You stay with a problem until you find the actual cause rather than a workaround.
* **Cross\-Disciplinary Curiosity:** Interest in how electronics, firmware, and mechanics come together in a working machine, and comfort working with engineers outside your discipline.
* **Communication:** Clear written and verbal skills. You document what you did and explain what you found so others can act on it.
* **Adaptability:** A driven self\-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity and able to pivot as priorities shift in a fast\-moving startup; willing to take on work outside your core role when required.
* **Nice to Have:** Experience with brushless motor control or motor drivers, sensor signal conditioning, PCB layout, or robotics projects.
* **Work Onsite:** Ability to work from our NYC office 5 days a week.

**What’s In It For You**
------------------------

* Join a trailblazing robotics and AI company building the future of recovery
* The chance to make a difference with a product that empowers healthier and happier living
* Team culture driven by passion, ambition, empowerment, inclusion, curiosity, and fun!
* 100% employer\-paid healthcare coverage for employees with generous coverage for eligible dependents
* Flexible time off
* Quarterly Wellness Days \- everyone fully unplugs
* Generous parental leave
* Complimentary OneMedical

ADUSA Distribution is the distribution company of Ahold Delhaize USA, providing distribution services to one of the largest grocery retail supply chains in the nation. Our team is supporting the supply chain network evolution to an integrated self\-distribution model of the future, serving leading omnichannel grocery brands \- Food Lion, Giant Food, The GIANT Company, Hannaford and Stop \& Shop. To learn more about our company and the other supply chain companies of Ahold Delhaize USA, visit www.adusasc.com.
  

  

**Position Summary**  

  

Are you passionate about transforming supply chain operations through cutting\-edge automation and robotics? As a **Specialist Automation Project Engineer**, you will play a key role in advancing ADUSA's automation strategy by designing, implementing, and optimizing innovative solutions that drive operational excellence across our supply chain network.
  

  

In this highly visible role, you will lead the development and deployment of advanced automation technologies, including robotics, automated material handling systems, and distribution center automation. You will collaborate with cross\-functional partners across Operations, Technology, Finance, and external vendors to deliver solutions that improve safety, quality, efficiency, service levels, and cost performance.
  

  

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced engineer and project leader who enjoys solving complex operational challenges, influencing strategic decisions, and driving meaningful business impact across a large\-scale supply chain network. * Collect and analyze operational and financial data to measure project success and ensure alignment with business goals.
* Lead network automation initiatives while minimizing operational disruption and maximizing value realization.
* Support all supply chain facilities, including company\-operated and third\-party locations.
* Partner with operations leadership to implement network changes that improve efficiency, service levels, and overall business performance.
* Work closely with external vendors on the design, support, maintenance, and performance of automation equipment and systems.

**Education \& Experience**  

* Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

* Strong experience designing, implementing, commissioning, supporting, and maintaining automation systems in distribution or warehouse environments.
* Experience with technologies such as:
* + Robotics

	+ Conveyor systems
	+ Pick\-to\-light solutions
	+ Automated Storage and Retrieval Systems (ASRS)
	+ Warehouse Control Systems (WCS)
	+ Warehouse Execution Systems (WES)
	+ Warehouse Management Systems (WMS)
* Advanced proficiency with AutoCAD (AutoCAD Electrical preferred), Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, and other Microsoft Office applications.
* Experience developing engineered labor standards, conducting time and motion studies, and building project plans and business cases.
* Understanding of vendor contracts and the ability to interpret scope, performance obligations, and service agreements.
* Knowledge of electrical, mechanical, PLC, and material handling maintenance systems.

  

**Skills \& Capabilities**  

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to develop practical, innovative solutions for complex operational challenges.
* Ability to interpret and present complex technical and financial information to various audiences.
* Excellent project management and organizational skills with experience managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Strong communication and relationship\-building skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across all levels of the organization.
* Resourceful, results\-oriented, and adaptable in fast\-paced environment

jobs.description:

Category: Engineering

widget: Full\-Time

Other
No \- Teleworking not available for this position

### **Position Description \& Qualifications**

  

  

If you want to work on cutting\-edge DoD programs, Serco has a great opportunity for you! As a SME Software Engineer, you will be supporting the Special Programs Division (AFLCMC/WAG) at Wright Patterson AFB, OH.

  



**This position is contingent upon the ability to maintain/transfer active Department of War (DoW) Top Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain TS/SCI.**

  



The Fighters and Advanced Aircraft Directorate, Special Programs Division develops, tests, and rapidly fields classified USAF aeronautical capabilities. AFLCMC/WAG conducts studies to identify new capabilities; transitions laboratory technologies to operational platforms; executes demonstrations; and develops, tests, rapidly fields, sustains, and demilitarizes capabilities for the warfighter.

  



In this role, you will:

  



* Oversee software engineering architecture of prime DoD contractors that are implementing Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) for a software pipeline in the acquisition, development, and sustainment of prototypes, aircraft, subsystems, and/or support equipment


* Using DevSecOps, evaluate prime contractor proposed software design changes and solutions for aircraft/test equipment, perform systems analyses and technological/trade\-off study assessments
* Assess the interfaces and interaction of a computer system’s software, firmware, and hardware


* Actively participate in software\-centric technical reviews and transitioning efforts from traditional methodologies to CI/CD


* Using MBSE, translate operational user requirements into contract system requirements documents to improve traceability
* Analyze software performance deficiencies; make recommendations for corrective action
* Audit DoD contractors for software configuration and control measures and verify appropriate quality accreditation


* Review the system design software architecture and interoperability requirements


* Evaluate system software test plans and participate in the conduct of system, subsystem, and component testing; review and analyze test data; make recommendations


* Support development and review of program and contract technical documentation
* Provide technical and programmatic feedback, develop and present technical briefings, and develop engineering strategies/analyses
* Conduct technical evaluations of contractor proposals
* Interface with weapons system contractors, vendors, and Government representatives on software engineering activities; independently apply software and engineering principles to investigate, analyze, plan, oversee, and evaluate weapons system development and sustainment
* Assess AFRL technology initiatives to guide investments and shape transition strategies
* Assess contractor product capabilities in achieving system design requirements and specifications
* Perform technical risk assessments and develop mitigation plans
* Develop request for proposal (RFP) technical documents and conduct technical evaluations of contractor proposals to include software design feasibility and system compatibility

  

To be successful in this role, you will have:  



* An active TOP\-SECRET security clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) and access to Special Access Programs (SAP) and have a background investigation current within the past 5 years or under Continuous Vetting
* Masters Degree in an Engineering discipline with a minimum of 20 years relevant experience with the DoD, other government agency, or DoD contractor
* Minimum 3 years of SAP or SCI experience within the last 5 years
* Ability to travel up to 10% (CONUS)

  

Additional desired experience and skills:


* Bachelor’s or Masters Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or Electrical Engineering
* In\-depth knowledge of DoD acquisition software engineering support to include software architecture, design, integration, configuration, test/evaluation, and certification
* Current knowledge of software development methodology and tools to include Agile and CI/CD
* Experienced with real\-time operating systems, software languages, computer hardware platforms
* Experience in integrating DevSecOps, MBSE, and DoD cybersecurity considerations into software architectures
* In\-depth knowledge of DoD acquisition engineering and test support

If you are interested in supporting and working with our Air Force and airmen and a dedicated Serco team, then submit your application now for immediate consideration. It only takes a few minutes!

  

  

### **Company Overview**

  

  

Serco Inc. (Serco) is the Americas division of Serco Group, plc. In North America, Serco’s 9,000\+ employees strive to make an impact every day across 100\+ sites in the areas of Defense, Citizen Services, and Transportation. We help our clients deliver vital services more efficiently while increasing the satisfaction of their end customers. Serco serves every branch of the U.S. military, numerous U.S. Federal civilian agencies, the Intelligence Community, the Canadian government, state, provincial and local governments, and commercial clients. While your place may look a little different depending on your role, we know you will find yours here. Wherever you work and whatever you do, we invite you to discover your place in our world. Serco is a place you can count on and where you can make an impact because every contribution matters.

### **Position Description \& Qualifications**

  

  

If you want to work on a cutting\-edge Air Force program, Serco has a great opportunity for you! As a **Senior Electrical Engineer**, you will be supporting the Special Programs Division (AFLCMC/WAG) at Tinker AFB, OK.  

AFLCMC/WAG develops, tests, and rapidly fields classified USAF aeronautical capabilities. Executing a significant budget, the AFLCMC/WAG conducts studies to identify new capabilities; transitions laboratory technologies to operational platforms; executes demonstrations; and develops, tests, rapidly fields, sustains, and demilitarizes capabilities for the warfighter.  

**An active U.S. Department of War (DoW) Top Secret security clearance with TS/SCI eligibility**  

In this role, you will:
* Perform duties in research, development, testing, evaluation, operation, and maintenance of electrical devices/systems on new and/or existing aeronautical vehicle systems and/or airborne or related ground systems avionics.
* Serve as the technical expert for the organization and provide advice/assistance to leadership on problems, issues, and projects as they relate to sustaining engineering.
* Develop and review the overall system electrical/electronic design baseline's architecture and interoperability requirements.
* Translate user requirements into system requirements, which are used to design, develop, test, and evaluate software, electrical and electronics for systems, subsystems, and equipment.
* Provide systems/subsystems integration support for the acquisition, development, sustainment and verification of systems, software, and equipment; demonstrate familiarity with USAF engineering processes and V diagram.
* Evaluate system test plans and participate in the conduct of system, subsystem, and component testing.
* Demonstrate experience with USAF technical orders and depot/field engineering support.
* Provide electronics engineering support during root cause analyses for assigned programs and demonstrate familiarity with the USAF eight step process.
* Read and generate changes to electrical and electronic drawings and mechanical drawings.
* Interpret computer aided design software for mechanical and electrical systems and model\-based design concepts.
* Develop technical papers/presentations, and clearly communicate concepts to program team.
* Support development and review of the full range of program and contract documentation.
* Conduct technical evaluations of contractor proposals.
* Perform technical risk assessments and develop mitigation plans.

  

To be successful in this role, you will have:  

* An active DoW Top Secret security clearance with the ability to obtain and maintain Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) and access to Special Access Program (SAP) and have a background investigation current within the past 5 years or under Continuous Vetting.
* A Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering from an ABET accredited program with a minimum of 12 years experience in an engineering position with the DoD, other government agency, or DoD contractor.
	+ OR a Masters Degree in a relevant engineering discipline with a Bachelor’s in Electrical/Electronics Engineering from an ABET accredited program and a minimum of 10 years experience in an engineering position with the DoD, other government agency, or DoD contractor.
* Minimum of 3 years of SAP experience within the last 8 years.
* The ability to travel up to 10% (CONUS).

  

Additional desired experience and skills:


* Familiar with basics of electrical and electronic circuits, Institute for Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE) standard communication circuits, radar, electro\-mechanical interface design, software control of electronic circuits.
* Familiar with analog to digital and digital to analog interfaces, electromagnetic interference, electromagnetic compatibility, circuit analysis, and safety of flight requirements in electrical and electronic circuitry.
* DoD acquisition program office experience focused on airborne weapon system sustainment.
* Experience in a SAP and/or SCI environment.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer - Sustaining and Product Development
jobs.description:
Overview:

Are you someone who is passionate, motivated, and driven to make a difference? If so, MSA Safety is the perfect fit for your career.  

At MSA, SAFETY is who we are AND it is what we do. We are a purpose\-driven company committed to deploying innovation and technology to deliver on our Mission to help protect people and assets all around the world. We continue to be relentless in our pursuit of solving our customers greatest problems so they can go home safe each and every day.  

Are you in? Read on for more details about this particular role.
Responsibilities:
* Responsible for Sustaining efforts in our Fixed Gas and Flame Detection product line
* Responsible for the design, analysis, testing and troubleshooting of electronic assembles integrated in safety products
* Incorporate electronic designs with software, mechanical, test and manufacturing capabilities in order to ensure successful products are delivered on time while meeting agreed upon product performance specifications.
* Participate on cross\-functional project teams in the development of new MSA products.
* Work with customers, both internal and external, to determine product design requirements.
* Perform design work including embedded systems, digital and analog circuitry, power supplies and connectivity interfaces
* Plan, prioritize, and complete engineering investigations on existing products, including resolving component obsolescence issues, investigate and provide data\-backed decisions on non\-conforming components and providing assistance with customer product inquiries
* Provide concise technical reports to support investigations and technical judgments
* Develop \& execute test plans to evaluate products/components
* Participate in design reviews for new products


Qualifications:

Special Skills, Knowledge and Abilities Required:

* Strong communication skills (written, verbal and presentation). Able to effectively communicate technical information to audiences of all levels, including management and external stakeholders.
* Highly motivated and self\-directed. Ability to perform complex tasks/assignments with limited supervision.
* Detail oriented, organized, with demonstrated analytical problem\-solving skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills. Must be able to work independently and in a team environment with multiple teams and challenging schedules.
* Proven expertise in circuit design, component selection and PCB physical construction for EMC compliant electronic circuits.
* Design experience with low power electronics for agency compliance for hazardous environments.
* Working knowledge of statistics.
* Solid verbal and written communication skills.
* Proven ability to work in a team environment.
* Demonstrated customer centric approach.
* Minimal travel required (less than 10%).
* Proficient in the use of Altium Designer for schematic capture and PCB design.
* Use of statistical tools (Mini Tab) and risk analysis (i.e. DFSS, FMEA).

jobs.title: Automation Engineer I
jobs.description:
**Join Our Automation Engineering Team**
Jam Works Automation is hiring an Automation Engineer I to support the design, programming, testing, integration, and commissioning of custom automated manufacturing systems.
This is a salaried/exempt, early\-career engineering opportunity for someone interested in building hands\-on experience across both controls and robotics. You’ll work alongside experienced engineers while developing skills in PLC/HMI programming, industrial robotics, electrical controls, system integration, troubleshooting, and commissioning.
Candidates may come into the role with stronger experience in either controls or robotics. You’ll have the opportunity to build broader automation experience while continuing to develop your existing technical strengths.
**Why Join Jam Works Automation?**
* Build hands\-on experience across both controls and robotics
* Work on custom automated manufacturing systems from programming through commissioning
* Learn directly from experienced automation engineers through project work, training, and mentoring
* Gain exposure to technologies including PLCs, HMIs, industrial robotics, drives, servos, vision systems, and safety systems
* Develop toward a longer\-term career path in Controls Engineering or Robotics Engineering as your technical skills and experience grow

**What You’ll Do**
* Support the design, programming, integration, testing, and commissioning of automated manufacturing systems
* Develop and modify basic PLC/HMI and robot programs with guidance from experienced engineers
* Work with technologies including Rockwell/Allen\-Bradley, AutomationDirect, FANUC robotics, and RoboGuide
* Assist with electrical drawings, control schematics, panel layouts, I/O documentation, equipment selection, and other engineering documentation
* Support the assembly, wiring, installation, checkout, and troubleshooting of control panels, field devices, robotic equipment, and automation components
* Participate in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), equipment start\-up, and commissioning
* Troubleshoot basic electrical, controls, robotics, and system\-integration issues
* Collaborate with Controls, Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Project Management, Manufacturing, and other teams throughout project execution
* Maintain accurate programs, drawings, backups, test records, and project documentation
* Travel to customer locations as needed for installation, commissioning, start\-up, and troubleshooting activities

**What We’re Looking For**
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Robotics Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related engineering discipline; equivalent relevant education and experience may be considered
* Typically 0–2 years of relevant experience in industrial automation, controls, robotics, manufacturing, or a related environment
* Internships, co\-ops, academic projects, and other relevant hands\-on experience are welcome
* Foundational knowledge of PLC/HMI programming, industrial robotics, electrical controls, and automated equipment
* Exposure to Rockwell/Allen\-Bradley, AutomationDirect, FANUC, or RoboGuide is preferred
* Ability to read and develop basic electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical drawings
* Basic understanding of sensors, I/O, motors, drives, servos, safety devices, and industrial communications
* Basic electrical and mechanical aptitude with the ability to safely use common hand and power tools
* Strong troubleshooting, communication, teamwork, and organizational skills
* Ability and willingness to learn new technologies and work in a hands\-on, project\-driven environment

**This Could Be a Great Fit If You**
* Enjoy figuring out how machines, controls, and robotic systems work together
* Want a role that combines engineering work with hands\-on equipment experience
* Are interested in developing skills across both controls and robotics before building deeper specialization
* Enjoy troubleshooting and solving technical problems
* Work well with engineers, technicians, manufacturing teams, and customers
* Are curious, adaptable, and motivated to keep building your technical skills

**Work Environment and Physical Requirements**
* Work is performed across office/engineering, manufacturing, assembly, and customer\-site environments
* The role may involve working around operating machinery, electrical equipment, robotic systems, and moving mechanical components
* Hands\-on work may include equipment assembly, wiring, installation, testing, and troubleshooting
* Ability to lift and/or move up to 25 pounds regularly and up to 50 pounds occasionally, with assistance as appropriate
* Frequent bending, reaching, stooping, kneeling, or crouching may be required when working around equipment and control panels
* Appropriate personal protective equipment and applicable company and customer safety procedures must be followed
* Travel to customer locations is required as needed for installation, testing, commissioning, start\-up, troubleshooting, and technical support
* Work schedules may occasionally vary based on project, commissioning, or customer requirements


**Equal Opportunity Employer**
Jam Works Automation LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer (M/F/D/V).

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
**Location: Lancaster, PA – Onsite, 5 Days/Week**  

 **Reports to: Maintenance \& Engineering Manager**  

 **Employment Type: Full\-Time**

**Position Overview**


Trillium Foods is seeking a hands\-on Electrical Engineer to support capital projects, automation, controls, and electrical systems within our food and beverage manufacturing operations.


This role will be actively involved in the design, development, installation, and improvement of electrical and automation systems supporting food processing, production, packaging, and facility operations. The Electrical Engineer will work directly with equipment and systems on the manufacturing floor, providing technical expertise from initial project concept and equipment specification through programming, installation, commissioning, startup, and ongoing optimization.


The ideal candidate will bring hands\-on electrical engineering, automation, and controls experience within the food and beverage manufacturing industry, along with experience supporting capital projects from concept through commissioning and startup.


This is not a role focused solely on coordinating or delegating engineering work. We are looking for someone who enjoys being directly involved in the technical work, solving problems, developing practical solutions, and taking ownership of projects and assignments.


The Electrical Engineer will work closely with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, EHS, OEMs, contractors, and external engineering partners while maintaining direct technical involvement throughout projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Capital Projects \& Project Ownership*** Take ownership of assigned capital projects supporting food processing, production, packaging, utilities, and facility operations.
* Develop project scopes, budgets, schedules, equipment specifications, technical requirements, and implementation plans.
* Provide hands\-on electrical and controls engineering throughout project design, installation, commissioning, and startup.
* Evaluate new equipment and technologies and ensure electrical and controls requirements are appropriately incorporated into equipment specifications.
* Work directly with OEMs, vendors, contractors, integrators, and external engineering partners while maintaining internal ownership of technical requirements and project execution.
* Review and challenge technical recommendations, drawings, specifications, and proposed solutions to ensure they meet operational, engineering, food safety, and reliability requirements.
* Support equipment installation, testing, commissioning, validation, and production startup directly on the manufacturing floor.
* Track project costs, schedules, risks, and performance while minimizing disruption to production.
* Identify opportunities to improve safety, food quality, equipment reliability, efficiency, capacity, and overall manufacturing performance.
 **Automation \& Controls*** Design, program, troubleshoot, modify, and optimize PLC and HMI systems supporting food and beverage manufacturing equipment and processes.
* Develop and implement automation solutions using PLCs, HMIs, SCADA systems, VFDs, industrial networks, instrumentation, and process controls.
* Support automation associated with processing, batching, mixing, filling, material handling, packaging, conveying, and other production systems.
* Troubleshoot controls and automation issues directly on production equipment and develop sustainable corrective solutions.
* Support integration between production equipment, controls, instrumentation, and related systems.
* Lead or support commissioning and startup of new and modified automated equipment.
* Develop and maintain control narratives, functional specifications, I/O documentation, electrical drawings, and other technical documentation.
 **Electrical Engineering*** Design, specify, troubleshoot, and support industrial electrical systems, including low\- and medium\-voltage distribution.
* Develop and review one\-line diagrams, load calculations, panel schedules, electrical drawings, and equipment specifications.
* Support motor control centers (MCCs), switchgear, transformers, generators, backup power systems, motors, drives, and other electrical infrastructure supporting plant operations.
* Support arc flash studies, short\-circuit analysis, electrical coordination studies, energy efficiency initiatives, and electrical reliability improvements.
* Ensure electrical systems and work comply with NEC, NFPA 70E, OSHA, and applicable electrical and safety requirements.
 **Food \& Beverage Manufacturing Support*** Maintain a strong presence on the manufacturing floor and provide hands\-on technical support to Operations and Maintenance.
* Troubleshoot complex electrical, automation, controls, and equipment issues affecting production.
* Partner with Operations and Maintenance on root cause analysis, corrective actions, equipment reliability, and continuous improvement.
* Develop engineering solutions that consider food safety, sanitary design, product quality, cleanability, employee safety, and production requirements.
* Support preventive and predictive maintenance initiatives for electrical and controls systems.
* Work effectively in an environment where engineering projects and troubleshooting activities must be coordinated around active production and sanitation schedules.
* Build strong working relationships across all levels of the organization and communicate technical information effectively to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
 **Engineering Standards, Food Safety \& Compliance*** Develop, maintain, and promote standardized engineering practices, hardware, and control platforms.
* Ensure engineering designs and equipment modifications consider applicable food manufacturing, sanitation, quality, and regulatory requirements.
* Review contractor drawings and engineering packages and ensure technical documentation is accurate and maintained.
* Partner

jobs.description:
**APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS:**
=============================

* **CURRENT PENN STATE EMPLOYEE (faculty, staff, technical service, or student), please** **login to Workday** **to complete the** **internal application process** **. Please do not apply here, apply internally through Workday.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **CURRENT PENN STATE STUDENT (not employed previously at the university) and seeking employment with Penn State, please** **login to Workday** **to complete the** **student application process.** **Please do not apply here, apply internally through Workday.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **If you are NOT a current employee or student, please click “Apply” and complete** **the application process for external applicants** **.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Approval of remote and hybrid work is not guaranteed regardless of work location. For additional information on remote work at Penn State, see** **Notice to Out of State Applicants** **.**

**POSITION SPECIFICS**

Your working location will be fully on\-site, located in State College, PA. This position will require periodic travel to remote locations (including the Electro\-Optics \& Electronics (EOE) Freeport Office near Pittsburgh, PA) in support of collaboration and testing as part of a small team of researchers, engineers, and technologists.


We are searching for a Research \& Development Engineer to join our EOE Division at the Applied Research Laboratory (ARL) at Penn State. EOE develops innovative optical solutions for imaging, high\-energy laser (HEL) delivery, and sensing systems, and maintains the design and testing capabilities required to build and fully characterize all aspects of optical performance – from image quality to HEL coating damage testing. This role will lead and conduct basic and applied research of advanced electro\-optical designs, including metasurfaces, photonic structures and other emerging material and nano\-science applications. You will have the ability to take on challenges where the path the research may take is not clear, and the outcome is not known or guaranteed.


ARL is an authorized DoD SkillBridge partner and welcomes all transitioning military members to apply.


You will:


* Act as part of team leadership that operates in this ambiguous space and develops the executable plan for the rest of the team
* Perform physics\-based modeling to predict the performance of imaging system concepts and designs
* Drive system level trade studies to develop architectures and allocate system level requirements across subsystems and engineering disciplines
* Routinely interface with sponsors, customers, end\-users, and collaborators to understand their problems, brainstorm solutions, scope research, communicate the technical aspects of research execution, and convey the significance of results
* Provide input to the strategic direction of the department’s research pursuits by helping to establish the appropriate core competencies and evaluating where our capabilities best align with a sponsor’s needs

Additional responsibilities of the higher\-level include:


* Leverage prior first\-hand experience with building and testing advanced, state\-of\-the\-art electro\-optic systems
* Track the latest developments in electro\-optic systems and advise on how and when to integrate them into on\-going and future research opportunities.
* Perform project planning, budgeting, and scheduling
* Manage vendors and suppliers, from purchase orders through statements of work
* Lead other engineers in day\-to\-day tasking to satisfy stakeholder’s requirements and expectations
* Independently manage multiple and/or large electro\-optic projects
* Develop and propose solutions for new applications
* Perform the role of Trusted Agent to the government to assess and validate state\-of\-the art electro\-optic systems and solutions

Required Skills/Experience areas include:


* Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment and meet project schedule requirements
* Direct experience with the design, analysis, procurement, assembly and testing of components and complete electro\-optic and infrared (EO/IR) systems for military applications
* Microelectronic systems and detector fabrication processes
* Success in a multitude of optical and electrical materials and systems
* Success operating as a systems engineer for imaging systems
* Familiarity with photonic structures and other optical metamaterial designs approaches
* Active security clearance, at the secret level, with eligibility for TS/SCI

Preferred Skills/Experience areas include:


* Experience within an organization responsible for manufacturing EO/IR systems
* Direct experience with visible and infrared imaging system design and characterization
* Strong knowledge of electro\-optical metamaterial designs approaches
* Radiometry (analysis and laboratory measurements), development of link budgets, prediction of sensor response, and image quality metrics
* Significant experience with electro\-optic designs that extend the electro\-optic state\-of\-the\-art
* Significant experience bringing together distributed teams to achieve multiplied results
* Active security clearance at the TS/SCI level or higher

**MINIMUM EDUCATION, WORK EXPERIENCE \& REQUIRED CERTIFICATIONS**

If filled as R\&D Engineer \- Optical and Photonic Systems (ARL) \- Principal Professional, this position requires:\&\#xa;Bachelor's Degree

	+ Python

* Experience with:

	+ Automated testing frameworks (e.g., Google Test)
	+ Containerization technologies (e.g., Docker)

* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* The ability to travel up to 10%

* Familiarity with PCX, MOAA, and/or DSIM (or similar frameworks)

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Network \& Controls Engineer designs, configures, integrates, and supports the secure communication paths that connect Nextracker’s field\-deployed tracker controllers, data hubs, SCADA systems, and customer networks to the Nextpower cloud environment.


This is an early\-career engineering role for a hands\-on problem solver who can work across network engineering, OT/SCADA connectivity, customer onboarding, systems integration, and process development. The role will support new project deployments and the operating fleet, working with Network Engineering, Controls and Software Engineering, Technical Services, Remote Monitoring, Field Services, Project teams, and customer IT/OT organizations.


The position is intended to build on the responsibilities of the Network Engineering Intern and expand them into full\-time ownership of defined network, SCADA, integration, and operational improvement workstreams.  



**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Network engineering and site connectivity**

* Design and review site connectivity solutions for new and existing solar projects, including routers, switches, firewalls, VPNs, cellular gateways, leased\-line connections, and related network services.
* Review customer IT/OT standards, network diagrams, IP plans, routing requirements, segmentation requirements, and firewall policies.
* Prepare clear connectivity packages for internal and customer review, including IP addressing, subnetting, required ports and protocols, routing, firewall rules, remote\-access requirements, and validation steps.
* Configure and test network equipment using approved templates, standards, and change\-management procedures.
* Establish and maintain reliable communication between field devices, customer networks, and Nextpower data centers.

### **Data hub and field\-network deployment**

* Configure, stage, validate, and support data hubs and related field\-network equipment before shipment or deployment.
* Apply project\- and customer\-specific configuration, including IP addressing, routing, VLANs, firewall rules, DNS, NTP, VPN parameters, and secure remote\-access settings as applicable.
* Perform software and firmware upgrades under established procedures, validate successful deployment, and document all changes.
* Support site installation and commissioning activities remotely and, when required, at customer or project locations.
* Verify that field equipment is accessible, secure, correctly configured, and ready to deliver required operational data.

### **OPC, SCADA, and industrial\-protocol integration**

* Support the integration and reliable transport of SCADA and industrial protocols between tracker controllers, data hubs, customer SCADA systems, historians, and control centers.
* Configure and troubleshoot OPC/SCADA data paths, including OPC UA and related gateway or interface components when applicable.
* Support integrations using protocols such as Modbus TCP, DNP3, IEC 61850, or other customer\-required interfaces.
* Validate data\-point availability, naming, quality, timestamps, update rates, scaling, alarms, and control paths after installation or configuration changes.
* Assist with SCADA point lists, interface requirements, network\-port matrices, test scripts, commissioning checklists, and integration closeout documentation.
* Work with Controls, Software, Product, and Technical Services teams to distinguish network, protocol, device, application, and data\-quality issues.
* Help define repeatable architecture patterns for connecting Nextracker equipment to customer SCADA and historian environments.

### **Customer onboarding and technical support**

* Work with customers, EPCs, SCADA providers, project teams, and senior engineers to establish and verify connectivity from project sites to the Nextpower environment.
* Lead defined portions of customer connectivity calls, technical reviews, remote troubleshooting sessions, and commissioning activities.
* Explain network requirements, required customer actions, validation tests, and open issues in a clear, professional, service\-oriented manner.
* Troubleshoot TCP/IP networks, VPN tunnels, firewalls, routing, switching, DNS, NAT, packet loss, latency, port access, and device communication.
* Gather logs and evidence, run diagnostic commands and tests, document findings, and maintain clear ticket updates through resolution.
* Communicate impact, status, risks, ownership, next steps, and expected timing to internal stakeholders and customers.

### **Cybersecurity, access control, and change management**

* Apply secure\-by\-default practices to network and OT connectivity, including least\-privilege access, restricted ports, network segmentation, approved remote\-access methods, jump hosts, MFA where applicable, and secure credential handling.
* Support cybersecurity upgrade programs across the installed fleet and help identify risks or configuration gaps.

Twenty\-Six Defense, headquartered in Fort Worth, Texas, is a leading provider of high\-performance products, system solutions, and aftermarket support services focusing on the defense, homeland security, and commercial aviation markets. jobs.title: Software Engineer - HIL
jobs.description:
**About Neuralink:**



We are creating devices that enable a bi\-directional interface with the brain. These devices allow us to restore movement to the paralyzed, restore sight to the blind, and revolutionize how humans interact with their digital world.

**The Role**



Neuralink's next generation surgical robot will perform brain surgery at scale, installing hundreds of tiny threads into the brain to enable brain computer communication.



You will own the robot's Hardware In the Loop (HIL) test system. Exercise the production surgical robot, controllers and firmware against controlled inputs, reproduce faults, and automate verification. Your HIL will enable unattended test \& verification to run day and night. Your work will help deliver reliable surgical robots at scale, bringing Neuralink to more people.


**What you'll do**


* Build and maintain robot HIL — real hardware running production software and firmware.
* Write automated HIL tests for integration, timing, faults, and bring\-up.
* Define pass/fail, coverage, and acceptance criteria.
* Wire software\-in\-the\-loop tests, HIL tests, and hardware acceptance into one CI pipeline with logs, traces, and reproducible results.
* Own release\-gating tests. When a failure escapes sim or HIL, you reproduce it and close the coverage gap.


***Note: The team is hiring engineers at all levels, both junior and senior. What matters most is evidence of exceptional abilities and a drive to succeed.***


**What we're looking for**


* Strong Rust skills; Python for test tooling and analysis. Comfortable close to drivers, firmware, and buses.
* Experience with HIL, test rigs, or system\-level verification on robots, vehicles, or similar hardware.
* Experience debugging async and concurrent systems, RPC, telemetry, and timing failures across software and firmware.
* Experience building automated test pipelines. Bazel experience is a plus.
* Effective at using AI agents to accelerate work while maintaining quality.
* Obsession with repeatability, edge cases, and traceability.

* An opportunity to change the world and work with some of the smartest and most talented experts from different fields

Reality Labs (RL) focuses on delivering Meta's vision through Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR) and Wearable AI Devices. The compute performance and power efficiency requirements of our AI devices require custom silicon. Reality Labs Silicon team is driving the state of the art forward with breakthrough work in computer vision, machine learning, mixed reality, graphics, displays, sensors, and new ways to map the human body. Our chips will unlock personalized on\-device AI capabilities and blend virtual, physical worlds on wearable devices.
